title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
description:
A Aira é uma plataforma de billing para empresas de tecnologia com operações complexas. Estamos construindo a infraestrutura que permite a empresas de software e IA operar modelos comerciais mais sofisticados (com cobrança por uso, contratos flexíveis e múltiplos produtos) sem depender de planilhas frágeis, fluxos manuais ou sistemas legados.

Acreditamos que pricing e billing não deveriam limitar a evolução de um produto ou a capacidade de uma empresa de adaptar seu modelo comercial à medida que cresce. Por isso, estruturamos o billing para acompanhar as necessidades reais do negócio, com mais flexibilidade, confiabilidade e controle sobre uma camada crítica da operação.

Hoje, já processamos mais de R$ 500 milhões em volume anual de faturas e seguimos crescendo rapidamente ao lado de clientes relevantes do mercado, como Celcoin e Raster.

Sobre a vaga

Na Aira, a função de BDR tem papel central no crescimento da empresa.

Você trabalhará direto com nosso CEO e será responsável por abrir portas, iniciar conversas relevantes e gerar oportunidades qualificadas para um produto que resolve um problema real e complexo em empresas B2B.

Esta é uma posição para quem já teve alguma vivência em pré-vendas e quer desenvolver repertório comercial com densidade: entender problema, construir abordagem, testar narrativa, evoluir processo e aprender vendas consultivas em um contexto exigente e de alto nível.

Mais do que apenas atuar na operação, a ideia da vaga é também participar diretamente da construção da área junto com a liderança. É uma posição que tende a fazer bastante sentido para quem quer ter mais contexto, mais proximidade com decisão e mais espaço para contribuir na criação de processo, abordagem e forma de execução, em vez de apenas operar algo já pronto.

Ao longo do tempo, você terá exposição direta a mentoria, desenvolvimento e crescimento profissional dentro de uma operação comercial em formação.

O que você vai fazer no dia a dia

Você atuará com foco em prospecção outbound consultiva, dentro de um processo já existente, mas com espaço real para evolução contínua e participação na construção da área.

No dia a dia, isso inclui:

  • Construir listas e segmentar empresas dentro do ICP da Aira
  • Utilizar ferramentas de AI para analisar gargalos no processo e otimizar seu fluxo de trabalho
  • Prospectar empresas via e-mail, LinkedIn e ligações
  • Criar abordagens personalizadas, incluindo vídeos curtos
  • Acompanhar respostas e realizar follow-ups estruturados
  • Qualificar leads antes de encaminhá-los para o time responsável pelo fechamento
  • Executar o processo com consistência, ao mesmo tempo em que contribui com sugestões e melhorias na forma como a área opera

O que você vai aprender na Aira

Trabalhando como BDR na Aira, você terá contato direto com:

  • Venda consultiva B2B para empresas de tecnologia
  • Estruturação de processos de outbound
  • Uso intensivo de ferramentas de AI aplicadas à prospecção
  • Análise de ICP, segmentação e priorização de contas
  • Construção de narrativa comercial para um produto complexo
  • Rotina comercial próxima de fundadores e com alto nível de contexto

Você deveria aplicar se:

  • Tem pelo menos 1 ano de experiência em pré-vendas, seja como SDR ou BDR
  • Tem interesse real em construir carreira em vendas B2B ou em funções comerciais dentro de empresas de tecnologia
  • Aprende rápido e responde bem a feedback frequente
  • Habilidades de escrita e comunicação excepcionais
  • Se motiva com a oportunidade de crescer junto com uma empresa em estágio inicial
  • Se sente confortável falando com perfis diferentes e iniciando conversas
  • Aprende rápido e gosta de evoluir com feedback frequente
  • Gosta de ambientes dinâmicos, com ritmo acelerado e espaço para crescimento
  • Heavy user de ferramentas de AI
  • Quer participar mais de perto da construção de processo, abordagem e operação comercial

Você não deveria aplicar se:

  • Precisa de muita estrutura, templates prontos e tarefas excessivamente definidas para conseguir executar bem, visto que estamos em um momento de reinvenção e de testes constantes
  • Você prefere um ritmo devagar. Somos uma empresa pequena, com um time extremamente ágil
  • Busca a previsibilidade, os benefícios e o nível de estrutura de uma empresa grande e já consolidada
  • Não tem interesse em lidar com autonomia, responsabilidade e exposição direta ao que funciona e ao que não funciona

title: GLOBAL DATA SCIENCE SPECIALIST III - QUANTITATIVE AND STATISTICAL GENETICS
description:
GDM is a global leader in plant genetics, dedicated to transforming agriculture through technological innovation. Our DNA

If you are passionate about learning and want to be part of transforming agriculture, GDM is the right place for you!

What will your routine look like working with us?

  • Accelerate the transformation of plant breeding programs through advanced analytics, experimental design, genomic prediction, and data-driven decision-making
  • Enhance genetic gain and improve breeding efficiency
  • Operate at the intersection of statistical genetics, data science, and breeding innovation.

Requirements to participate in the process:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Agronomy or Agricultural Engineer, with a Master’s and/or PhD in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or Plant Breeding
  • Conduct advanced quantitative data analysis of large field & genotypic datasets
  • Optimize breeding strategies, crossing systems, and selection decisions
  • Hands-on experience with genomic prediction methodologies, including Linear mixed models, Bayesian approaches, and Machine learning methods applied to plant or animal breeding
  • Experience with breeding simulation, optimization methods, and decision-support tools, including modeling of genomic, phenotypic, and environmental effects, selection response and expected genetic gain
  • Proficiency in analytics tools (R and/or Python) and statistical frameworks such as ASReml, BGLR, etc.

Brazil (Campinas - SP; Passo Fundo - RS; Cambé - PR; Lucas do Rio Verde - MT; Rio Verde - GO; Porto Nacional - TO; Petrolina - PE);

Argentina (San Isidro - Buenos Aires; Chacabuco - Buenos Aires);

United States (Westfield - Indiana)

At GDM , we believe that diversity strengthens our team and drives innovation. We are committed to building an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and respected.

Our positions are open to all talents, and we encourage applications from people with different perspectives and backgrounds. At GDM, the diversity of ideas and experiences is what drives us forward in the evolution of agriculture.

title: Senior Financial Analyst
description:
Senior Financial Analyst

Location: Remote (Brazil)

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Senior Financial Analyst to support reporting, billing processes, and revenue operations. This role will play a critical part in ensuring financial accuracy, optimizing workflows, and delivering insights that drive business performance as the organization scales.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly analytical and detail-oriented Senior Financial Analyst to support financial operations, reporting, and billing processes. This role will act as a key partner across Finance, Sales, and Customer Success teams, ensuring alignment between contracts, invoicing, and revenue recognition. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical thinking with hands-on experience in billing, revenue operations, and financial reporting. This role requires both strategic insight and operational execution, contributing to process improvements and supporting the company’s financial health and scalability.

What You'll Do:

  • Analyze financial performance, identify trends, and deliver actionable insights to support strategic decision-making
  • Enhance financial reporting, tools, and processes to improve efficiency, accuracy, and scalability
  • Ensure customer contracts are aligned with invoicing terms and revenue recognition policies
  • Prepare and process invoices accurately and in a timely manner, resolving discrepancies when needed
  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure billing accuracy and proper contract implementation
  • Monitor accounts receivable, track outstanding balances, and follow up on overdue payments
  • Maintain accurate billing records and supporting documentation for audits and reporting
  • Contribute to optimizing and streamlining the quote-to-cash process
  • Support financial reporting cycles and assist with audits related to billing and revenue operations
  • Perform ad-hoc financial analysis and support additional finance-related initiatives.

What You Bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 4–7+ years of experience in financial analysis, billing, accounting, or revenue operations
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, revenue recognition principles, and financial reporting
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, and Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or financial systems is a plus
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organizational skills
  • High attention to detail with the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate financial data into clear, actionable insights.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with billing or subscription-based business models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process optimization and financial systems improvements
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations.

What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern financial systems and tools
  • High-impact role supporting financial strategy and operations
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Tech Lead
description:
Descrição da vaga

Na Loopia, estamos crescendo rápido e construindo soluções que transformam o e-commerce. Buscamos um(a) Tech Lead que combine excelência em sistemas distribuídos com fluência real em IA aplicada ao desenvolvimento alguém que lidera tanto a arquitetura dos sistemas quanto a evolução do time rumo a uma cultura AI-first.

Se você se entusiasma com sistemas de alta escala e com a próxima geração de coding agents, e acredita que desenvolver pessoas é o maior multiplicador de impacto de um Tech Lead, venha fazer história com a gente.

Suas responsabilidades
  • Liderar decisões de arquitetura e design de sistemas distribuídos de alta disponibilidade e performance.
  • Projetar e implementar APIs robustas e escaláveis em Python (Django, FastAPI).
  • Arquitetar soluções para processamento de grandes volumes de dados em AWS, com foco em resiliência e eficiência de custos.
  • Estruturar o uso de IA generativa no ciclo de desenvolvimento (Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor e similares), definindo boas práticas, guardrails e workflows agentic que ampliem a produtividade real do time.
  • Capacitar o time em fluência de IA, de prompt engineering a construção de pipelines com agentes, RAG, promovendo uma cultura de aprendizado contínuo.
  • Definir padrões técnicos, conduzir code reviews e garantir qualidade e consistência da base de código.
  • Mentorar o time tecnicamente, conduzir 1:1s e PDIs, e apoiar processos seletivos e onboarding.
  • Participar ativamente de decisões de trade-off entre complexidade, velocidade de entrega e escalabilidade.
O que buscamos em você
  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos em desenvolvimento backend, com pelo menos 2 anos em posição de liderança técnica.
  • Histórico comprovado em projetos de escala, alto volume de requisições, dados massivos ou arquiteturas distribuídas.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Python e frameworks como Django, FastAPI ou Flask.
  • Domínio de AWS: Lambda, ECS/EKS, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB e IaC (CloudFormation/Terraform).
  • Experiência sólida com microsserviços, event-driven architecture e padrões de resiliência (circuit breaker, retry, dead-letter queues).
  • Experiência com bancos relacionais (MySQL, PostgreSQL) e não-relacionais (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis).
  • Uso ativo de coding assistants no dia a dia, com experiência prática em agentes, tool use, RAG, MCP.
  • Experiência com Docker, Kubernetes, pipelines de CI/CD e práticas de DevOps/SRE.
  • Conhecimento em message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka) e observabilidade (CloudWatch, Datadog ou similar).
  • Capacidade de mentorar engenheiros e comunicar decisões técnicas complexas para diferentes públicos (engenharia, produto, liderança).
Benefícios

Cartão de benefícios flexível → R$ 1.200

Vale alimentação ou refeição

Plano de saúde

Plano odontológico

Day off no aniversário

Frutas e snacks a vontade

️ Além de um ambiente para desenvolvimento profissional e pessoal

Sobre a Loopia

A Loopia é uma empresa de tecnologia focada em agentes de IA para vendas e atendimento no e-commerce. A gente resolve um desafio grande e caro para o varejo digital: atender clientes de forma inadequada é perder vendas.

Nossa plataforma conecta marcas e varejistas aos principais canais onde as pessoas compram hoje: Mercado Livre, Shopee, Amazon, TikTok Shop, Magalu, WhatsApp e outros. Automatizamos o atendimento da pré-venda ao pós-venda com agentes de IA que respondem em questão de segundos, 24h por dia, 7 dias por semana, automatizando o trabalho repetitivo, e mantendo as pessoas no loop para as demandas onde é essencial uma atenção humanizada.

Estamos crescendo rápido e escalando Brasil afora, atendendo marcas e varejistas de médio e grande porte.

A Aperam BioEnergia, líder em inovação e sustentabilidade, está em busca de uma pessoa Gerente de Área Silvicultura e Colheita para integrar a equipe.

A Aperam BioEnergia se consolidou como referência em inovação e sustentabilidade no Vale do Jequitinhonha, produzindo carvão vegetal de alta eficiência para a fabricação do Aço Verde Aperam, além de tecnologias, mudas, Biochar e Bio-óleo.

Ao utilizar 100% de carvão vegetal em nossos altos-fornos, na usina siderúrgica de Timóteo (MG), conseguimos reduzir significativamente a nossa pegada de carbono. Isso quer dizer que, além de altamente eficiente, o nosso aço contribui para um futuro mais limpo e sustentável.

Valorizamos pessoas e comunidades, promovendo saúde, segurança e programas sociais que transformam vidas. Na Aperam BioEnergia, sustentabilidade e inovação caminham lado a lado para criar um impacto positivo, corajoso e duradouro.

Se você é apaixonado(a) por sustentabilidade e quer fazer parte de uma transformação positiva no setor florestal, esta é sua oportunidade!

Somos um lugar incrível para trabalhar! No segmento de Agronegócio, conquistamos o 1º lugar no Prêmio “Lugares Incríveis para Trabalhar” , posição que mantemos há seis anos. Esse reconhecimento reflete o nível de satisfação de nossas pessoas colaboradoras e nossa excelência em gestão de pessoas, clima organizacional e liderança.

Acreditamos que a diversidade fortalece nossa equipe e que a inclusão é essencial para um ambiente mais inovador e colaborativo. Buscamos pessoas que queiram crescer em um time que valoriza diferentes perspectivas e experiências.

title: Sales Manager
description:
About Us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. In 2025, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. This was followed by our entry into Brazil, progressing from a pilot in Santos and São Vicente to an official launch in São Paulo, with more destinations ahead.

  4. Cross-functional Collaboration — working with Product, Ops, Marketing, and Finance to align BD with company priorities
  5. Competitive Analysis & Market Intelligence — monitoring trends and translating insights into strategy

What We Need From You:

  • Relevant experience BD/partnerships/commercial roles (tech, e-commerce, or delivery)
  • Market entry experience in Brazil
  • Strong relationship building and negotiation skills
  • Strategic/analytical thinking in fast-moving environments
  • Execution-oriented and results-driven
  • Adaptable and resilient in high-growth settings
  • Fluent English and Portuguese

What Makes This Role Exciting

Join Keeta at a pivotal moment as we scale across continents. You'll play a central role in shaping our market entry strategy, building partnerships that define our brand presence, and directly contributing to the growth of one of the world's most ambitious food delivery platforms. Collaborate with a world-class, diverse team across multiple geographies, gain unparalleled international exposure, and see the tangible impact of your work as new markets come to life. This is not just a job—it's an opportunity to build something global from the ground up.

title: Analista Fiscal junior
description:
Cargo: ANALISTA FISCAL JUNIOR

Objetivo do Cargo: Garantir a integridade fiscal de todas as operações de entrada e saída da empresa, realizando a validação de impostos, classificação de mercadorias e conformidade com a legislação vigente (Federal, Estadual e Municipal).

1. No Recebimento de Notas (Entradas):

• Validação de XML: Verificar a autenticidade e validade das NF-es e CT-es junto ao SEFAZ.

• Análise Tributária de Fornecedores: Validar o destaque de impostos (ICMS, IPI, PIS, COFINS) e a aplicação de Retenções na Fonte (ISS, IRRF, CSLL, PIS, COFINS) em notas de serviço.

• Conformidade de NCM e CFOP: Auditar se a classificação fiscal (NCM) dos itens recebidos está correta e determinar o CFOP de entrada de acordo com a destinação (uso/consumo, revenda ou industrialização).

• Substituição Tributária (ICMS-ST): Conferir cálculos de antecipação tributária e diferencial de alíquota (DIFAL) nas entradas interestaduais.

2. No Faturamento (Saídas):

• Determinação de Regras Fiscais: Configurar ou validar a matriz tributária no ERP para que a saída de mercadorias aplique as alíquotas corretas de impostos.

• Emissão de Notas Complexas: Executar o faturamento de operações específicas, como triangulação, venda à ordem, remessa para conserto, demonstração e devoluções.

• Gestão de Documentos Fiscais: Monitorar a autorização de NF-e, NFS-e e MDF-e, garantindo o correto tratamento de notas rejeitadas ou canceladas.

3. Requisitos Técnicos Essenciais:

• Legislação: Conhecimento profundo em CST (Código de Situação Tributária), regimes de tributação (Lucro Real/Presumido) e regras de crédito de impostos.

• Sistemas: Domínio em módulos fiscais de ERPs e Totvs.

• Atualização: Capacidade de acompanhar e aplicar mudanças frequentes na legislação tributária.

Benefícios: VT, VR e VA

title: Ads Sales Executive | Samsung Ads
description:
Job Title: Ads Sales Executive | Samsung Ads

Highlights :

  • Location: São Paulo - SP.
  • Type of contract: Permanent contract, Full time
  • Work Modality: On Site

Who are we?

Samsung Electronics has grown into one of the world’s leading technology companies, recognized as one of the top 5 global brands. As a global leader in technology, we are transforming the world with the creativity and diversity of our talented people who drive this transformation.

Our company's success reflects the determination and talent of our people, aligned with our key corporate values: People, Excellence, Change, Integrity, and Co-prosperity. Our mission is to help people achieve the impossible.

We are inspired by what people want to accomplish in their lives and work to create products that empower them in new ways. This drive fuels our innovation.

Join us at Samsung and find your opportunity to do what you can't.

Looking for more? Visit our website or our career page !

Job Description

Samsung Ads, the advertising monetization arm of Samsung Electronics, leverages proprietary real-time TV viewing behavior and insights to promote relevant brand and content experiences to consumers. We partner with brands, agencies and content owners to deliver unique advertising opportunities on native placements within our Smart TV platform and programmatically with a cross device solution.

Samsung’s unique first party data help brands and media owners connect to their audience as they explore content across desktop, mobile, tablets and our Smart TVs. The Samsung Ad platform delivers high-quality audience targeting powered by three key components: first-party audience data at scale, world-class data science, and brand-safe cross-device ad inventory.

We are looking for a Sales Executive to help lead this transformation in Brazil. This role is for someone who understands that the future of CTV advertising is not only about reach. It is about intelligence, interaction, measurement and business outcomes. We need a sales professional who masters consultative discovery, builds trust with senior clients and agencies, and co-creates solutions that solve real business challenges.

Key Job Responsabilities

  • Strategic Discovery & Client Understanding

Deep Discovery: Lead senior-level consultative conversations to uncover the real business challenge behind each brief. Move beyond media metrics such as impressions and CPMs to identify core client problems, including market share pressure, brand consideration, churn, incremental reach, product adoption or sales acceleration.

Active Listening: Act as the voice of the client internally, translating complex brand and agency needs into clear commercial opportunities and tailored advertising strategies.

Business Problem Framing: Help clients understand how Samsung Ads can support their broader marketing objectives, from brand building to measurable outcomes.

  • Co-Creation & Strategic Partnership Development

Solution Co-Creation: Partner with agencies, clients and internal teams to design holistic CTV solutions using Samsung’s proprietary data, premium inventory and full-funnel capabilities.

Custom Audience Strategy: Use Samsung’s ACR and device-level intelligence to build relevant audience strategies, custom segments and unique media experiences that go beyond off-the-shelf planning.

Value-Based Selling: Structure, negotiate and close high-impact partnerships focused on long-term value, not one-off transactional revenue.

Executive Relationship Building: Build senior relationships across brands and agencies, becoming a trusted advisor on the future of TV, CTV and full-funnel video advertising.

  • Data-Driven Evangelism & Market Education

CTV Evangelism: Educate the Brazilian market on the shift from traditional TV planning to data-driven, audience-first and outcome-based CTV strategies.

From Attention to Action: Build compelling narratives showing how Samsung Ads connects high-impact TV environments with measurable business outcomes.

Measurement Leadership: Guide clients through modern measurement solutions, including incrementality, brand lift, reach extension, cross-device attribution and performance signals.

Market Thought Leadership: Represent Samsung Ads in senior meetings, agency sessions and strategic forums with clarity, confidence and strong command of data.

  • Pipeline, Revenue & Territory Ownership

Full Ownership: Own a book of business with entrepreneurial discipline, prioritizing strategic accounts, growth opportunities and high-potential advertisers.

Pipeline Discipline: Build and manage a transparent, high-quality pipeline with clear next steps, decision-makers, timelines and commercial upside.

Revenue Delivery: Consistently drive revenue growth by converting strategic conversations into scalable partnerships, packages and long-term commitments.

Cross-Functional Leadership: Work closely with Client Solutions, Insights, Product, Marketing and Operations to ensure that the commercial vision is executed with excellence.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration or other relevant areas.
  • Sales Experience: Experience in consultative sales within media, digital advertising, AdTech, CTV, TV, streaming platforms or premium advertising environments.
  • CTV & Digital Fluency: Strong understanding of the evolution of video, connected TV, OTT, programmatic media and the Brazilian advertising ecosystem.
  • Strategic Selling DNA: Ability to identify business problems, map stakeholders, build influence and sell complex solutions to senior clients and agencies.
  • Data Fluency: Comfort working with audience data, measurement, insights and performance narratives.
  • Executive Communication: Strong ability to present sophisticated strategies to C-level executives with clarity, confidence and business relevance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset: Ability to work through ambiguity, connect dots and build solutions rather than simply sell inventory.
  • Language: Advanced English is mandatory.

Why is Samsung Electronics the place to be?

Join a Global Team : Work with a dynamic and diverse team, constantly interacting with different cultures.

Tackle Big Challenges : Our history is built on overcoming challenges and striving for excellence. Join us in pushing the boundaries of technology and innovation.

Shape the Future : Collaborate in an open, innovative environment where your ideas come to life, creating products that redefine the future.

Make an Impact : Contribute to groundbreaking technologies that improve lives and support communities worldwide. At Samsung, your work truly makes a difference.

Benefits :

  • Comprehensive health and wellness programs
  • Professional development opportunities
  • Global networking and collaboration

At Samsung, we want you to be yourself! We prioritize fairness and will never request personal information unrelated to the selection process, such as marital status, age, gender, religion, or political opinions.

description:
A Phibro Animal Health Corporation é uma organização global de capital aberto com uma rica história em saúde e nutrição animal que fabrica e comercializa aditivos medicamentosos para alimentação animal, vacinas, produtos de especialidades nutricionais e nutrição mineral. Nós nos esforçamos para ser um parceiro confiável para os produtores de gado, aves, suínos e aquacultura, agricultores, veterinários e consumidores que criam ou cuidam de animais de produção e de companhia, fornecendo soluções para ajudá-los a manter e melhorar a saúde de seus animais.

A Phibro é uma empresa diversificada. Além de nutrição e saúde animal, fabricamos e comercializamos produtos para melhorar a performance na produção de etanol, microbianos para plantas, aplicações domésticas e industriais e especialidades químicas para vários mercados industriais.

As receitas da Phibro são superiores a US$ 1 bilhão e são suportadas por mais de 2.300 colaboradores em todo o mundo.

Na Phibro, as pessoas são nosso maior patrimônio. Nós nos esforçamos para desenvolver uma força de trabalho diversificada que promova um ambiente onde as pessoas se sintam apoiadas em compartilhar abertamente sua criatividade e habilidades que lhes permitam ser o mais bem-sucedidas possível.   • Liderar o desenvolvimento de campanhas e materiais de marketing em parceria com equipes internas e agências, incluindo conteúdos técnicos e promocionais.
  • Acompanhar o mercado e a concorrência, produzindo análises que subsidiem decisões estratégicas e oportunidades de crescimento.

description:

Soft Skills

title: Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)
description:
Project Analyst (Petroleum Exploration & Production)

Curitiba/PR, Brazil

Position type: Full-Time, in-person

Reports to: Regional Director, IPA-LA

Date posted: May 7, 2026

Closing date: Open until filled

Introduction

Are you interested in how the oil and gas Exploration & Production (E&P) world is transitioning? Do you love making connections and solving puzzles or problems? Are you detailed and focused, yet you also have broad interests and ideas and excellent communication skills? Do you enjoy analytical research work while also being comfortable client-facing?

If so, please apply as a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production in IPA’s Latin America office! The Project Analyst will lead evaluations and consulting for major energy players to help them improve the effectiveness of their capital projects.

About the Role

Independent Project Analysis (IPA) has an opening position in our Latin America office (located in Curitiba/PR, Brazil) for a Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production . The candidate should have a proven track record working on capital projects or analyzing project feasibility in the upstream oil & gas market. Candidates are required to have strong analytical skills, intellectual curiosity, and a desire to contribute as a thought leader. Aptitude for and demonstrated skills to be a successful analyst include your ability to connect in real life with the data and vice versa, to know when to ask more questions and when to just listen, as well as to be self-motivated to learn and thrive.

IPA’s client portfolio includes world-leading companies in both the heavy and light industries around the world. IPA has offices in the United States, the United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia, Brazil, and Singapore; as such, major industry leaders globally rely on us to assess the health of their capital project systems and provide recommendations to improve their performance. IPA evaluates hundreds of capital projects every year, developing very complete technical, business, and people histories from their front-end through early operation. These histories become the data we use to find what works and what does not work in capital projects. The IPA project databases are unique and the most comprehensive sources of capital project experience in existence. IPA also takes a leading role in empirical research into the drivers of better projects and project systems using our extensive databases of past project performance.

Responsibilities

General responsibilities of the role include:

  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Interfacing with clients to collect and analyze technical, cost, schedule, and project management data
  • Writing reports with insight and a customer focus
  • Delivering verbal feedback and public presentations
  • Conducting research on the drivers of project success or failure using proprietary databases and statistics

Day in the Life

Responsibilities of the Project Analyst – Petroleum Exploration & Production role include:

  • Interfacing directly with clients in person to collect project data and uncover areas of risk
  • Applying statistical analysis to quantify your findings
  • Writing reports to provide insight and recommendations for clients
  • Delivering verbal feedback and presentations to technical and business audiences
  • Working directly with capital project teams and project organizations of major E&P companies to improve business competitiveness
  • Conducting research on drivers of project success and failure using IPA’s proprietary databases and statistics

Skills and Qualities

Project Analysts – Petroleum Exploration & Production must have:

  • Demonstrable Portuguese and English language oral and written communication skills; fluency in Spanish is an advantage
  • Solid analytical skills
  • Ability to demonstrate intellectual curiosity and organizational leadership
  • Excellent listening, presentation, and report writing skills with strong attention to detail
  • Strong interpersonal skills to develop and maintain relationships at senior levels with client companies and liaise with people from other cultures
  • Strong work ethic
  • High self-motivation and ability to work independently
  • Positive attitude and willingness to work in a team
  • Ability to work to tight deadlines and under pressure
  • Flexibility in taking on a variety of assignments

Travel

  • This position requires up to 30 percent travel; candidates are required to have proper documentation for necessary business travel
  • Travel will be required primarily within Latin America and is primarily on weekdays

Education and Experience

  • A Master’s degree (preferred) or Bachelor’s degree or the equivalent in engineering, science (physics, chemistry, petroleum, geology), statistics, operations research, economics, or related fields
  • Minimum of 3 years of relevant experience with upstream oil and gas projects
  • Proven record of carrying out independent research or using a variety of statistical methods to analyze large amounts of data

WHY IPA?

For over 35 years, IPA has delivered groundbreaking research and quantitative risk analyses to enhance the value generated by our clients’ capital project systems and meet their obligations for sustainable and safe performance. IPA guides capital‑intensive organizations to establish the right combination of people, work process, and governance to maximize performance across several measures: cost, schedule, safety, operability performance, and carbon reduction. We have a dataset of over 24,000 capital projects as the basis of our work. Our clients are leading companies in the energy, minerals, infrastructure, chemicals, pharmaceutical, and consumer products sectors. IPA is committed to social and ethical responsibility, and all global offices initiate or participate in local charity initiatives to support those in need .

HOW TO APPLY

Applicants should complete the form at and include a cover letter, resume, and salary requirement.

title: Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior — .NET / Desktop Cross-Platform
description:
Engenheiro(a) de Software Sênior — .NET / Desktop Cross-Platform

Híbrido/ Local Barueri

Sobre a oportunidade

Buscamos uma pessoa sênior para atuar como referência técnica no desenvolvimento de um agente desktop corporativo multiplataforma (Windows, macOS, Linux), parte central de uma plataforma SaaS B2B enterprise. O agente roda em larga escala em parques de clientes corporativos, com responsabilidade sobre coleta de telemetria, gestão de endpoint e integrações de produto. A plataforma processa hoje milhões de mensagens por dia , em operação tanto em cloud quanto on-premises nos ambientes dos clientes — e o agente está na ponta que gera boa parte desse volume.

Em paralelo, a pessoa atua na evolução dos serviços de backend em .NET que sustentam a plataforma e participa da migração gradual de serviços legados para a arquitetura .NET atual . Parte desses serviços legados está em Node.js e Python — não esperamos entrega solo nessas stacks, mas esperamos autonomia para ler e executar esse código a fim de entender o comportamento que está sendo migrado.

Procuramos um perfil de engenharia ponta-a-ponta : alguém que pensa em produto, arquitetura, ambiente local, observabilidade, segurança e experiência do desenvolvedor — não apenas no código de uma feature isolada.

Foco da posição

  • Primário — desenvolvimento e evolução do agente desktop em C# / .NET , com paridade entre Windows, macOS e Linux.
  • Secundário — evolução de serviços de backend em .NET (APIs e workers) que se comunicam com o agente e sustentam o backoffice da plataforma.
  • Apoio — leitura e execução de serviços legados em Node.js e Python como parte do trabalho de migração para .NET.

Stack-chave

Onde se espera entrega autônoma

  • C# / .NET — em sistemas reais, em produção
  • Aplicações desktop cross-platform em .NET (Windows, macOS, Linux)
  • APIs REST e integrações
  • Processamento assíncrono e mensageria
  • Bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis)
  • Containers e CI/CD
  • Microsoft Azure como plataforma de cloud

Onde se espera consumidor consciente da plataforma

Não esperamos que essa pessoa seja a dona da plataforma de cloud, do cluster ou da stack de observabilidade. Esperamos autonomia para diagnosticar, operar e tomar boas decisões de design sobre o que afeta o serviço dela:

  • Kubernetes — uso de linha de comando no dia a dia (logs, exec, port-forward, descrição de recursos), leitura de manifests, entendimento dos componentes essenciais. Suficiente para diagnosticar um problema e abrir uma issue precisa para a plataforma.
  • Microsoft Azure — entender as primitivas de cloud usadas pelo serviço (armazenamento, mensageria, gestão de segredos, telemetria) o bastante para tomar boas decisões de design, sem necessidade de provisionar.
  • Observabilidade — raciocínio sistêmico: correlacionar logs, métricas e traces, formular hipótese a partir de evidência, escolher o indicador certo para o problema, saber o que instrumentar e por que . Sem responsabilidade por operar a stack.

Onde se espera ler e executar

  • Node.js — rodar serviços localmente, debugar, entender o fluxo
  • Python — rodar workers e scripts, entender o que está sendo migrado
  • Angular / Ionic — leitura e ajustes pontuais quando o problema cruza fronteira frontend/backend

Responsabilidades

  • Evoluir o agente desktop em produção com foco em estabilidade, segurança, performance e paridade entre sistemas operacionais .
  • Reduzir dívida técnica e elevar o padrão do código.
  • Participar das migrações de serviços legados para a arquitetura .NET atual, com decisões orientadas por contrato e risco — não por reescrita cosmética.
  • Atuar em troubleshooting de produção com método: hipótese, evidência e ação reversível.
  • Apoiar, quando necessário, a análise de chamados de N2 e N3 , com o compromisso de gerar base de conhecimento a cada caso resolvido — de forma que novos acionamentos da mesma natureza sejam tratados nos níveis anteriores e parem de escalar para N3.
  • Conduzir code reviews que ensinam, refinamentos com decomposição clara e documentação útil.
  • Apoiar desenvolvedores plenos e juniores sem virar gargalo.
  • Contribuir para um ambiente local replicável onde qualquer pessoa do time consiga rodar a plataforma inteira sem dor.

Hard skills obrigatórias

Desenvolvimento

  • C# em nível avançado, com base sólida em .NET
  • Experiência com aplicações .NET rodando em mais de um sistema operacional — não apenas Windows
  • APIs REST, integração e processamento assíncrono
  • Concorrência e padrões de resiliência em sistemas distribuídos
  • Mensageria assíncrona e padrões associados (idempotência, dead-letter, ordenação)

Bancos de dados

  • Modelagem relacional e NoSQL
  • Otimização de queries
  • Estratégias de cache

Qualidade

  • Testes unitários e de integração como parte do fluxo, não como tarefa separada
  • Code review como ferramenta de elevação do time
  • Histórico de Git inteligível

Segurança

  • Gestão de segredos
  • Secure coding e OWASP
  • Atenção ao contexto desktop: distribuição assinada, atualização segura e proteção de credenciais locais

Outras stacks (no nível "ler e executar")

  • Capacidade comprovada de ler e rodar Node.js e Python para entender o comportamento de um serviço a ser migrado

Diferenciais

  • Experiência com agentes ou serviços rodando em endpoint do cliente (não apenas servidor)
  • Experiência com frotas distribuídas e telemetria em larga escala
  • Vivência com SaaS multi-tenant
  • Vivência com plataformas enterprise B2B
  • Experiência prévia com migrações de stack sem reescrita big-bang
  • Arquitetura orientada a eventos
  • Uso de IA e code agents no ciclo de desenvolvimento

Soft skills

Buscamos uma pessoa que:

  • Discuta soluções com arquitetos sem ego — defenda posições com dados, mude de ideia diante de argumento melhor.
  • Traduza complexidade técnica para negócio.
  • Colabore real com QA, SRE, UX e produto, sem virar silo.
  • Peça ajuda cedo, compartilhe contexto e evite heroísmo.
  • Tenha ownership : investigue causa raiz e traga proposta junto do diagnóstico.
  • Tenha maturidade sob pressão : em incidente, priorize fato, log e evidência; ação reversível antes de ação heroica.
  • Tenha mentalidade de produto : questione requisitos quando preciso.
  • Tenha humildade técnica : ensine, aprenda, faça code review para elevar pessoas.
  • Tenha pragmatismo : arquitetura que entrega vence arquitetura bonita.

title: Data Software Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.

Role Details:

We are looking for a talented senior data engineer specializing in building a highly scalable, cloud-based GraphQL API layer to deliver sports and betting data across multiple digital platforms. This role involves creating a seamless and efficient data ingestion, processing, and delivery system, integrating data and high-performance querying. You'll work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement a federated GraphQL architecture, driving the future of sports and betting data integration within the our clients digital ecosystem.

Your Day-to-Day:

  • Build new foundational capabilities using domain-driven design and test-driven development that will power features and experiences on various CBS Sports properties.
  • Help lead team members in the design, development, and optimization of our core sports GraphQL subgraphs and services within a federated architecture.
  • Participate in scrum ceremonies: daily standups, grooming, and sprint planning.
  • Practice DevOps: writing good tests and deploying continuously to production with observability and monitoring.
  • Review your teammates' designs and code, providing constructive feedback and engaging in technical discussions, including weekly deep-dive sessions on various topics.
  • Work with product partners to develop technical solutions for features leveraging GraphQL for data integration.

Key Projects:

  • Building out a GraphQL API for seamless data access and integration across multiple services.
  • Designing and building out a core data layer to power all CBS Sports Digital products, ingesting, processing, and storing data from hundreds of sources over different transports and data stores.
  • Defining a distributed tracing system for web services and data observability within a GraphQL ecosystem.
  • Containerizing core systems to reduce the overhead of infrastructure management.
  • Migration of legacy applications and services to our core data ingestion and GraphQL workflows.

Qualifications: What you bring to the team

You have:

  • 5+ years of experience in data engineering and data system development.
  • Experience in designing, implementing, and maintaining GraphQL schemas, optimizing query performance, and ensuring seamless data retrieval and manipulation for enhanced user experiences.
  • Experience with Javascript/TypeScript, Python, Node.js.
  • Experience with relational, NoSQL, and key-value data stores such as MySQL, DynamoDB, MongoDB, Redis.
  • Hands-on experience working in a distributed cloud-based environment with high transaction volumes, using a variety of connected services.
  • Proficiency with modern build strategies, continuous integration, unit testing, and automated integration tests (GitHub, issue tracking tools like Jira, and CI/CD related disciplines like GitOps).
  • Ability to design solutions, provide estimates, and evaluate risk and technical feasibility.
  • BS Computer Science, Engineering, a related technical degree, or equivalent professional experience.

You might also have:

  • Wundergraph, Cosmo, or Apollo GraphQL experience.
  • AWS Certifications.
  • Experience with extract, transform, load (ETL) pipelines using cloud services and frameworks (a plus).
  • Experience at an online company in digital media or content creation.
  • Excellent team player and communicator capable of creating positive relationships across engineering, product, and architecture.
  • Energetic self-starter who can work in a complex, collaborative environment that rewards innovation, initiative, curiosity, and mentoring.
  • Knowledge of sports and gaming.

title: Payroll Senior Analyst
description:
Hi there! Thanks for your curiosity

We’re driven by ambition and guided by a bold vision for the years ahead. As we scale our profitable ecosystem of tools and services, we’re seeking a standout Payroll Senior Analyst to help us go to the next level. In this position you will report directly to the Senior Finance Manager .

Who we are

Zubale is a technology company that enables retailers to win in eCommerce. We serve a wide range of retailers from supermarkets, specialty stores, pharmacies, department stores and fashion brands across Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Costa Rica, Peru and Colombia. How? We have three key products:

1) Flexifleet: Freelancer Marketplace to perform picking, packing, and delivery tasks for retailers and aggregators.

2) Fulfillment Optimizer: Modular Software to increase productivity in eCommerce picking, packing and delivery.

3) Consumer Connect: AI WhatsApp Conversational Commerce to boost sales and elevate customer experience.

We are passionate about helping brands, aggregators, and retailers optimize their eCommerce operations, lower costs, and boost profitability. Backed by over $70M USD in venture capital, we’ve delivered consistent growth over the past six years and completed more than 100 million orders through our platform. Today, we serve 100+ customers and engage thousands of freelancers across our network. And this is just the beginning. We're building a profitable, scalable ecosystem — and our vision is to become the #1 partner for retailers to grow their eCommerce business.

Who we are looking for

  1. We are seeking an End-to-End Payroll Owner with an operational, strategic and analytical mindset, capable of executing the payroll operation with full ownership. The ideal candidate combines operational excellence with the ability to collaborate with the Finance and Accounting Team.
  2. We are looking for a leader to implement a new Payroll System and Program in Brazil .

What you will do

  1. End-to-end Payroll (fixed + variable pay).
  2. Salary & Severance: Handling calculations, pay stubs, and legal settlements.
  3. Compliance: Managing social security payments and regulatory filings.
  4. Labor Certifications: Overseeing processes and legal obligations.
  5. Compensation Analysis: Benchmarking roles/shifts for internal pay equity.
  6. Strategic Hiring: Creating plans to boost budget efficiency and cut costs.
  7. Data Insights: Generating payroll reports for leadership decisions.
  8. Process Optimization: Driving continuous improvement in payroll workflows.
  9. Time & Attendance: Tracking and analyzing staff attendance.

The skills and experience you will bring

  1. Solid Experience: 5+ years of end-to-end experience managing complex payroll processes.
  2. Finance Knowledge: General accounting principles.
  3. Leadership: Experience leading teams or large-scale projects.
  4. Resilience: Proven ability to thrive in high-pressure, fast-paced environments.
  5. Critical Thinking: A proactive perspective on problem-solving.
  6. Management: Strong supplier and stakeholder management skills.
  7. Implementation: Experience with payroll system migrations or project implementations.
  8. Tech Savvy: Curiosity and experience with AI and automation tools.
  9. Languages: Professional Working Proficiency in English or Spanish (B2/C1 level). Please note: language skills will be tested during the interview process.

title: Especialista de Software I (Mobile)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como referência técnica em desenvolvimento mobile, contribuindo para a evolução das aplicações da UOL EdTech (OPM) com foco em qualidade, escala e experiência do usuário.
  • Definir e sustentar arquitetura de soluções mobile (modularização, padrões, camadas, offline-first quando aplicável, gestão de dependências, observabilidade e segurança).
  • Projetar e implementar funcionalidades complexas em Flutter, React Native, Android nativo (Kotlin/Java) e iOS nativo (Swift/Obj-C), avaliando trade-offs de cada abordagem.
  • Liderar decisões técnicas sobre estratégia multiplataforma vs nativo, performance, acessibilidade, integração com SDKs e evolução do ciclo de vida dos apps.
  • Conduzir integrações com APIs e serviços, garantindo resiliência (retries, cache, idempotência quando aplicável), e boas práticas de autenticação/autorização.
  • Implantar e evoluir práticas de engenharia: code review, padrões de código, testes automatizados, CI/CD mobile, release management e monitoramento em produção.
  • Atuar na melhoria contínua de performance (startup time, memory, battery, render), estabilidade (crashes/ANRs) e experiência (UX, tracking, analytics).
  • Colaborar com Produto, Design, Dados, Engenharia e Plataforma para definir soluções ponta a ponta e garantir entregas previsíveis.
  • Promover uso prático de IA para acelerar o desenvolvimento e a operação (ex.: automação de testes, análise de crashes/logs, geração de documentação e assistentes internos para troubleshooting).
  • Mentorar pessoas do time, apoiando evolução técnica, boas práticas e cultura de engenharia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Experiência com IA aplicada em mobile.
  • Uso de copilots/agentes no fluxo de desenvolvimento.
  • Estratégias para avaliação de código, geração de testes e documentação.
  • Integração com SDKs/APIs de IA (quando aplicável), com foco em privacidade e custo
  • Vivência com arquitetura orientada a módulos, design systems e componentes compartilhados (mobile e/ou cross-plataform).
  • Experiência com observabilidade avançada (ex.: Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics/Performance, Sentry) e definição de SLIs/SLOs para apps.
  • Experiência com integrações de SDKs de terceiros (analytics, antifraude, biometria/prova de vida, pagamentos, deep links, push).
  • Conhecimento de segurança mobile (OWASP Mobile, secure storage, certificate pinning, hardening).
  • Experiência em ambientes multi-produto / multi-squad e apps white-label.

Informações adicionais

Para se destacar nessa posição, seria legal se você também tivesse:

  • Atuação em um ecossistema com múltiplas integrações e alta criticidade de estabilidade, performance e experiência do usuário.

  • Apoia tecnicamente a definição da população-alvo dos estudos clínicos, garantindo que os critérios de inclusão e exclusão estejam alinhados aos objetivos científicos, às necessidades não atendidas e às exigências regulatórias aplicáveis aos desenhos de pesquisa clínica;
  • Identificar, avaliar e recomendar Líderes de Opinião (KOLs) relevantes para os estudos clínicos, considerando expertise científica, experiência clínica, reputação acadêmica e alinhamento ético, de modo a fortalecer a condução dos projetos e a credibilidade científica da companhia;
  • Revisar criticamente os procedimentos médicos descritos nos protocolos de pesquisa clínica, assegurando coerência científica, segurança dos participantes, aderência às Boas Práticas Clínicas (GCP) e alinhamento com as diretrizes médicas e regulatórioas vigentes.
  • Apoiar o relacionamento técnico-científico com os Investigadores Principais e centros de pesquisa, atuando como ponto focal médico para esclarecimentos científicos, alinhamentos e suporte durante as diferentes fases dos estudos clínicos.
  • Contribuir para a análise e acompanhamento da segurança dos participantes de pesquisa, apoiando a avaliação médica de eventos adversos, sinais de segurança e relatórios periódicos, em colaboração com as áreas de farmacovigilância e pesquisa clínica;
  • Dar suporte à definição dos desfechos de eficácia e à construção de claims médicos, assegurando que estejam fundamentados em evidências científicas robustas, resultados clínicos consistentes e em conformidade com os requisitos éticos e regulatórios;
  • Emitir parecer médico sobre benefícios clínicos, lacunas terapêuticas e necessidades m(édicas não atendidas, contribuindo de forma estratégica para a priorização e direcionamento dos projetos de inovçaão e desenvolvimento de novos medicamentos.

title: Professor(a) de Artes Visuais
description:
Position: Visual Arts Teacher

Section: Early Childhood Education (ECE) and Elementary School

Application Deadline: May 15, 2026

Start Date: July 15, 2026

Main responsibilities: Plan, deliver, and develop Visual Arts lessons for Early Childhood and Elementary students, aligned with BNCC, the IB PYP framework, and the school’s pedagogical approach. Promote inquiry-based, creative, and student-centered learning experiences that foster curiosity, imagination, and artistic expression. Design developmentally appropriate learning experiences, exploring a variety of media and techniques such as drawing, painting, collage, and sculpture, encouraging exploration, experimentation, and the development of artistic skills. Support students’ holistic development by fostering cognitive, social, emotional, and creative competencies, while encouraging growing autonomy, reflection, and a sense of identity. Ensure a safe, inclusive, and welcoming learning environment that supports student well-being and confidence to take creative risks. Use formative and observational assessment strategies to monitor and document student progress. Differentiate instruction to meet diverse learning needs in collaboration with the learning support team. Actively contribute to the development of the Arts program through curriculum planning, interdisciplinary projects, exhibitions, and school events, while maintaining effective communication with families.

Requirements: Teaching degree ( Licenciatura ) in Visual Arts. Fluency in English (Portuguese is desirable). Teaching experience, preferably in bilingual or international settings. Ability to work effectively with students from diverse cultural backgrounds. Strong communication, problem-solving, and organizational skills. Familiarity with educational technology tools and platforms. A Master's degree and IB PYP experience are considered desirable.

About the Company: School of the Nations is an international, nonprofit K-12 school inspired by the Bahá’í teachings, School of the Nations was founded with the primary purpose of unlocking human potential through academic excellence, the cultivation of moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service for the betterment of society. School of the Nations is an authorized International Baccalaureate (IB) School offering the Primary Years (PYP) and the Diploma (DP) Programs. Accredited as an international school by NEASC, our strategic development is guided by the ACE Learning Ecosystem 2.0.

Shared Understanding of High-Quality Learning

High-quality learning at the School of the Nations is rooted in our aspiration to release human potential through academic excellence, moral and spiritual qualities, and a lifelong commitment to service, empowering learners to develop the capacities of heart and mind to understand the world and contribute to the betterment of society.

In an inclusive, diverse, and globally-minded community, our students develop cognitive, creative, physical, spiritual, and social-emotional abilities; learners are agents of their own learning, actively setting goals, engaging in rich and complex challenges, and documenting growth; they demonstrate depth of understanding, collaboration, reflection, and multiple perspectives across disciplines.

Learning happens through a coherent, inquiry-based curriculum grounded in spiritual principles and practical applications, with diverse assessment and feedback guiding meaningful growth.

School of the Nations is an equal-opportunity employer. We encourage people with disability to apply.

Sobre a empresa: A Escola das Nações é uma instituição internacional, privada, sem fins lucrativos, coeducacional e duolinguística (inglês e português), localizada em Brasília. Oferecemos um programa educacional que vai do berçário ao 12º ano e somos credenciados internacionalmente pela NEASC e, nacionalmente, pela Secretaria de Educação do Distrito Federal. Com estudantes e colaboradores de 30 países e origens diversas, promovemos um ambiente de aprendizado inclusivo que incentiva a cidadania global e valoriza a diversidade.

Compreensão Compartilhada de Aprendizagem de Alta Qualidade

A aprendizagem de alta qualidade na Escola das Nações está enraizada em nossa aspiração de liberar o potencial humano por meio da excelência acadêmica, do desenvolvimento de qualidades morais e espirituais e de um compromisso contínuo com o serviço, capacitando os alunos a desenvolverem as capacidades do coração e da mente para compreender o mundo e contribuir para o aprimoramento da sociedade.

Em uma comunidade inclusiva, diversa e com visão global, nossos estudantes desenvolvem habilidades cognitivas, criativas, físicas, espirituais e socioemocionais; os alunos são agentes do próprio aprendizado, definindo metas ativamente, engajando-se em desafios ricos e complexos e documentando seu crescimento; demonstram profundidade de compreensão, colaboração, reflexão e a capacidade de considerar múltiplas perspectivas entre as diferentes áreas do conhecimento.

A aprendizagem acontece por meio de um currículo coerente e baseado na investigação, fundamentado em princípios espirituais e aplicações práticas, com avaliações diversificadas e feedback que orientam um desenvolvimento significativo.

A Escola das Nações é um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades. Incentivamos pessoas com deficiência a se candidatarem.

title: Metadata Coordinator
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a Metadata Coordinator , who wants to learn and transform his career.

In this role you will

Data Solutions

  • Manage scientific metadata across internal studies and external published datasets.
  • Curate metadata into structured workbooks, validate it against controlled dictionaries, and upload it into databases.
  • Bridge collaboration between scientists, bioinformaticians, and data engineers to ensure metadata is complete, consistent, and ready for processing.

Data Processing & Pipeline Support

  • Run CLI‑based upload workflows to load curated metadata and processed data into the database.
  • Create and maintain YAML configuration files for study processing.
  • Write SQL queries to validate, troubleshoot, and audit metadata in relational databases.
  • Write shell and Python scripts to automate repetitive metadata tasks.
  • Triage and resolve metadata‑related pipeline failures.

External Data Acquisition

  • Download and process external datasets from public repositories such as NCBI GEO and SRA.
  • Collate metadata from internal clinical data management systems.
  • Prepare metadata workbooks for published studies by extracting key elements from scientific publications.
  • Map external data formats to internal metadata standards.

Cross‑Team Coordination

  • Serve as the main point of contact for metadata requests from scientists and bioinformaticians.
  • Translate scientific requirements into structured metadata, including assay types, sample hierarchies, and study designs.
  • Coordinate with bioinformatics teams on shared vocabularies and pipeline metadata requirements.

Mandatory Skills

  • Strong SQL skills, including writing and debugging queries with joins, aggregations, and data validation patterns.
  • Shell scripting experience (Bash), including file manipulation, text processing (awk, sed, grep), and task automation.
  • Python scripting proficiency for data manipulation, file parsing, and integration tasks.
  • Experience working with metadata, ontologies, or controlled vocabularies in a scientific or data management context.
  • Comfort working in a Linux or HPC command‑line environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and ability to enforce data quality standards.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with both technical and scientific stakeholders.

Desirable Skills

  • Life sciences background (e.g., genomics, transcriptomics, or other omics domains).
  • Experience with public omics repositories.
  • Familiarity with YAML and JSON configuration or data serialization formats.
  • Database administration or data modeling experience.
  • Experience with data pipeline orchestration tools such as Dagster, Airflow, or similar platforms.

title: Supply Plannig specialist
description:
Join us at Orbia Building & Infrastructure Amanco Wavin: Where purpose comes to life.

You’re purpose driven. Growth minded. Ready to stretch your potential. Welcome to Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, where our purpose ‘to advance life around the world’ drives our entire global team.

Where purpose comes to life, it changes lives. This is what we work for. How about you?

At Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin), we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments. And where is our help most needed? The places we live in: cities where drinking water is leaking away, greenery is disappearing, streets are flooding after heavy rain, and outdated sewer systems are polluting our groundwater. It’s time to join our team and help build more sustainable environments!

We are currently looking for a Supply Plannig Specialist to join us at Sumaré, Brazil . If you want to make a difference and work for a purpose-led company, please read on.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze medium- and long-term capacity (6 months to 5 years).
  • Develop footprint scenarios and plant capacity balance.
  • Identify growth opportunities, bottlenecks, and future needs.
  • Support investment decisions, prioritization, and capacity allocation.
  • Prepare budgets related to capacity and operations.
  • Create and maintain scenarios in SAP IBP, applying best practices.
  • Support S&OP planning cycles with structured analyses and recommendations
  • Provide support to S&OP and S&OE teams by working in a stewardship role.
  • Drive inventory optimization initiatives linked to cost and service.
  • Migrate reports to Power BI and build executive-level dashboards with reliable data.
  • Promote continuous improvement through automation, AI, and process standardization.

Profile:

  • The ideal candidate will have a strong background project management, planning process improvement , or planning system implementation.
  • Solid knowledge and hands-on experience with SAP IBP and Power BI is required.
  • Professional working proficiency in English.
  • 5 years of experience as a Supply Planning Specialist or Senior Supply Planning Analyst within the manufacturing or logistics industry.

*Please attach your Cv in English

What Orbia Building & Infrastructure offers

Do you want to make a difference by working with a purpose? Count on a warm welcome at Orbia Building & Infrastructure (Wavin)! Here we take responsibility for each other and our company. We stay brave in pursuing calculated risks that fuel innovation. And we embrace diversity in perspectives, skills and talents to transform the way we work and the impact we have on the world. Above all we encourage all our employees to develop their talents and to become the best version of themselves. Together, as a strong team, we grow and deliver on our purpose every day. Orbia B&I is the place to be if you truly wish to make an impact. In addition to working with an enthusiastic, professional team in an international environment, we offer a competitive compensation and benefit package.

Organization

Orbia’s Building & Infrastructure business, Wavin, is an innovative solutions provider for the global building and infrastructure industry. Backed by more than 60 years of product development experience, we advance life around the world by building healthy, sustainable environments for global citizens. Whether it’s to improve the distribution of clean drinking water, to make sanitation accessible for everyone, to create climate resilient cities, or to design comfortable living spaces, Orbia B&I collaborates with municipal leaders, engineers, contractors, and installers to help future-proof communities, buildings and homes. Orbia B&I has 11,000+ employees and 65 production sites worldwide, serving over 80 countries through a global sales and distribution network. Our key commercial brands are: Wavin, Amanco Wavin, Pavco Wavin, Plastigama Wavin, and Bow Wavin.

Orbia Building & Infrastructure is part of Orbia – a company driven by a shared purpose: to advance life around the world. Orbia operates in several sectors including: Polymer Solutions (Vestolit and Alphagary), Building and Infrastructure (Wavin), Precision Agriculture (Netafim), Connectivity Solutions (Dura-Line) and Fluor and Energy Materials (Koura). These five Orbia business groups have a collective focus on expanding access to health and wellness, reinventing the future of cities and homes, ensuring food and water security, connecting communities to information and accelerating a circular economy with basic and advanced materials, specialty products and innovative solutions. Orbia has a global team of over 24,000 employees, commercial activities in more than 100 countries and operations in over 50, with headquarters in Boston, Mexico City, Amsterdam and Tel Aviv. The company generated $8.2 billion in revenue in 2023.

Formação Superior Completa em Engenharia Mecânica, Materiais, Química ou afins;

Sólida vivência com extração por moendas e difusores;

Experiência com gestão de pessoas, processos e custos.

Qual localidade?

Olímpia - SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Sales Director ( Chinese speaking)
description:
Sales Director – Brazil

Our client is seeking a Chinese speaking commercially driven Sales Director to lead and expand their business across Brazil. This role will be responsible for market development, strategic account growth, and building a strong local ecosystem across key industrial sectors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the execution of the company’s strategy in Brazil across branding, product positioning, sales, and service delivery
  • Drive market expansion by identifying opportunities and developing industry-focused growth plans across sectors such as oil & gas, petrochemical, energy, power, metallurgy, building materials, pulp & paper, food & pharmaceutical, and mining
  • Develop and manage relationships with both Chinese-invested enterprises and local clients, converting leads into sustainable business opportunities
  • Identify and engage high-value strategic accounts, strengthening the company’s presence within key industries
  • Build, develop, and manage a regional client portfolio, ensuring long-term partnerships and revenue growth
  • Establish and expand a strong distributor and partner network, creating a scalable and structured channel ecosystem
  • Lead selected direct sales initiatives, including involvement in EPC projects, FDI/ODI-related business, and complex deal execution
  • Oversee the development and implementation of online and digital sales channels where relevant
  • Provide market insights and feedback to support product strategy and long-term planning
  • Support additional business initiatives as required by leadership

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above, ideally in Automation, Engineering, or a related field
  • Minimum 5 years of international or cross-border sales experience, with a strong track record in business development and project execution
  • Proven experience leading or managing sales teams and delivering commercial results
  • Existing network or customer relationships within relevant industrial sectors is highly desirable
  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and execution skills, with a hands-on and resilient approach
  • Fluent Portuguese is essential, along with a good understanding of Brazilian and wider Latin American business culture
  • Willingness to travel and commit to long-term engagement in Brazil
  • Experience in automation, digitalisation, or industrial technology sectors is preferred

Additional Information

  • Candidates of Chinese background or with strong cultural and business alignment to Chinese enterprises are highly preferred

title: Presales Manager
description:
About Hanshow:

Founded in 2012, Hanshow is a leading provider of digital store solutions serving traditional retail, new retail, pharmacies, department stores, fashion, health care, and the entertainment industries, etc. We provide ESL and smart store solutions in 50+ countries. Hanshow is a trusted partner among retailers worldwide. We strive to enhance the shopping experience by developing cutting edge technology and providing services to solve our clients' in-store challenges. Our innovative spirit begins with our global team, improves the way we operate, and ultimately helps us deliver compelling end-to-end solutions.

For more information, please visit our website:

Pre-sales Manager

Are you looking for new challenges to level up your career? Would you like to play a key role in a fast-growing tech team? Are you deeply interested in new technologies which make life easier? Do you have the ambition to join an organization that has a global impact?

Here’s an incredible opportunity for you in Hanshow!

As Pre-sales Project Manager you will be the next driving force behind Hanshow Technology in Brazil. You are self-motivated and have a can-do attitude. You will be working closely with other senior leaders across a variety of departments.

What you will do:

  1. Proactively scope the technical solutions required to address customer requirements and challenges, assess customers’ needs, and recommend solutions that optimize value for the customer and Hanshow; Monitor deal progress from a pre-sales perspective and keep an open eye on how solutions can be maximized in customer and commercial value.
  2. Promote and provide seminars, create high-level visionary demos, and build and verify value scenarios, sales, and communication concepts. Present solutions, capabilities, and credentials in proposal defense meetings and during customer discussions.
  3. Deliver RFx responses and create customer proposals and POC.
  4. Proactively build and keep knowledge and skills up to date.
  5. Coordinate closely with the Sales Support function and Service resources to provide solution design to customers’ business requirements and support the sales team to proactively position infrastructure management services solutions.
  6. Achieve assigned sales targets growth in specified product lines, market areas, channels, or supported teams.
  7. Provide professional guidance and suggestions to team members and pre-sales associates to enhance their product knowledge, technical acumen, and technical sales skills.

Whom are we looking for:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent knowledge (preferably Computer Science, Electronics, Telecommunication, or related fields).
  • 3+ years of professional experience.
  • Familiar with Linux, JavaScript, SQL, Gantt charts, and Microsoft tools such as MS Project, MS Excel, MS power point, MS Visio, etc.
  • You are self-motivated and have a “can-do” attitude.
  • Have at least one of the skills in Linux operating system except for Windows, and have relevant experience.
  • Dynamic, stress-resistant, and a team player; Skilled at multitasking and working effectively in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities to meet the deadline, and address problems decisively and objectively.
  • You can coordinate multiple projects at the same time and are good at assessing risks.
  • You love and understand technology.
  • Have the ability to build and expand the network with customers.
  • Have project management skills to drive initiatives to the required outcome.
  • Ability to discuss requirements and design solutions with customers.
  • Ability to participate in multi-lingual meetings, and excellent communication skills.
  • Language Requirement: Portuguese and Mandarin

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary above average in the relevant industry.
  • Promising and sustainable self-development and prospects.
  • Wide technical and modern environment with interesting challenges.
  • Professional environment with an open communication culture.

title: Chief Commercial Officer
description:
Organização nacional de grande escala, com operação multi-regional e elevada complexidade, atravessa um momento estratégico de qualificação do crescimento, com foco em consistência, previsibilidade e qualidade de decisão. Esse estágio exige elevação do padrão de gestão, maior integração entre estratégia e execução e uso rigoroso de dados como base decisória.

É nesse contexto que buscamos um(a) Chief Commercial Officer (CCO) . A cadeira é central para organizar a agenda comercial, sustentar a execução em múltiplas regiões e modelos de negócio e assegurar decisões ancoradas em disciplina, governança de performance e leitura econômica.

Como CCO, a missão será estruturar e conduzir a estratégia comercial de forma integrada, traduzindo direcionamentos em planos executáveis e decisões bem priorizadas, com liderança madura sobre uma estrutura executiva ampla e impacto direto na previsibilidade de resultados e na sustentabilidade do negócio.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Conduzir a agenda estratégica do negócio comercial, conectando leitura aprofundada de mercado, posicionamento competitivo, proposta de valor, pricing e canais;
  • Traduzir direcionamentos estratégicos em planos executáveis, com prioridades claras, sequenciamento lógico e acompanhamento rigoroso;
  • Estabelecer critérios de priorização e alocação de recursos, assegurando foco em um ambiente de alta complexidade;
  • Consolidar a gestão orientada por dados como base das decisões executivas, garantindo qualidade, consistência e leitura crítica dos indicadores;
  • Implantar e sustentar ritos de gestão que assegurem ritmo, disciplina e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Liderar diretamente uma estrutura executiva ampla, incluindo diretores regionais e frentes corporativas;
  • Desenvolver lideranças, estabelecer padrões de gestão e garantir alinhamento entre estratégia central e execução regional;
  • Atuar como ponto de integração entre frentes corporativas e regionais, assegurando coerência estratégica e clareza decisória;
  • Conduzir decisões comerciais com visão econômica integrada, considerando impactos em capex, opex, margem e retorno;
  • Promover a evolução organizacional por meio da revisão de estruturas, processos e modelos, com postura analítica e investigativa.

Qualificações

  • Trajetória executiva em ambientes complexos, com operações de escala, múltiplas unidades ou atuação multi-regional;
  • Experiência em negócios de serviços, tecnologia, infraestrutura, consumo recorrente ou mercados correlatos, com forte interface entre estratégia e execução;
  • Histórico consistente de liderança de estruturas executivas amplas e responsabilidade direta por decisões e resultados;
  • Forte atuação com dados, inteligência de mercado e métricas de performance como base decisória;
  • Capacidade de estruturar problemas complexos, priorizar iniciativas e sustentar execução disciplinada;
  • Leitura econômica apurada e conforto para tomar decisões com informação incompleta, assumindo responsabilidade por riscos e impactos;
  • Vivência prévia em consultoria estratégica ou atuação equivalente será considerada diferencial relevante.
  • Disponibilidade para residir em São Paulo - SP

title: Executivo Comercial Hunter para Grandes Contas - Mercado Pago | Curitiba, PR
