title: Desenvolvedor Backend Senior em Golang
description:
E aí, tudo azul por aí?

A Turbi é a locadora do futuro: 100% digital, movida a tecnologia, gente boa e paixão por transformar a forma como as pessoas se locomovem. A gente abre carro pelo app (sim, sem chave!) e acredita que inovação de verdade começa com um time engajado e com liberdade pra criar.

Estamos procurando uma pessoa para a posição de Desenvolvedor Backend Senior, alguém que queira acelerar com a gente nessa jornada.

O seu papel por aqui:

Nesta posição Desenvolvedor Backend Senior , você será protagonista na construção de sistemas robustos e de alto desempenho. O foco central será a entrega de valor através de soluções de engenharia que sustentem a escalabilidade do negócio, garantindo a satisfação dos nossos clientes e o cumprimento das metas de expansão para 2026.

Mais do que entregar tarefas, a ideia é construir junto com autonomia, responsabilidade e espaço pra testar, errar e aprender.

O que você vai encarar no dia a dia:

  • Comunicação e Empatia: Capacidade de expor dificuldades e problemas de forma clara, demonstrando empatia com os desafios dos times e compreendendo demandas de áreas não técnicas.
  • Desenvolvimento Backend: Atuar no desenvolvimento de sistemas e aplicações voltadas para o ecossistema de IoT.
  • Apoio e Escalada: Suportar o time e outras áreas de negócio em regime de escala (escalations) durante um final de semana por mês.
  • Padronização: Utilizar ferramentas e padrões estabelecidos pela empresa para a construção de novas soluções.
  • Qualidade e Entrega: Realizar a entrega de sistemas, acompanhando de perto os indicadores de qualidade e a experiência de uso.

O que esperamos de você:

  • Backend de Alta Performance: Experiência comprovada no desenvolvimento de serviços de alto desempenho.
  • Kubernetes: Domínio da ferramenta sob a perspectiva de desenvolvimento.
  • Controle de Versão: Sólidos conhecimentos em GIT.
  • Arquitetura: Vivência sólida no desenvolvimento de microsserviços distribuídos e escaláveis.
  • Segurança: Experiência na disseminação e implementação de práticas de desenvolvimento seguro (Security by Design).
  • Resolução de Problemas: Experiência em troubleshooting em ambiente de produção, aplicando contramedidas imediatas e desenvolvendo soluções definitivas.
  • Soft Skills: Perfil colaborativo e focado em trabalho em equipe.
  • Stack Principal: Domínio em GoLang, MySQL, Redis, MongoDB, REST, OAuth 2.0, Swagger e ambientes Linux/Unix.
  • Diferenciais (Bom saber): PostgreSQL, Google Cloud (Pub/Sub, Cloud Task, AppEngine), OpenID Connect, Flyway, Load Balancers, Containers, JavaScript, Curl e JIRA.
  • Banco de Dados: Experiência prática com bancos de dados Relacionais e Não Relacionais (NoSQL).

O que a Turbi oferece pra te apoiar nessa jornada?

  • Salário competitivo no modelo PJ, alinhado com o mercado;
  • Saúde em dia : plano de saúde SulAmérica pra cuidar de você.
  • Sorriso garantido : plano odontológico Bradesco.
  • Corpo em movimento : acesso ao Wellhub ou Totalpass pra treinar do seu jeito.
  • TurbiFree todo mês : R$ 1.000 pra usar nossos carros como quiser.
  • Pausa merecida : 30 dias de recesso remunerado depois de 12 meses com a gente.
  • Parabéns com folga : Day Off no seu aniversário pra comemorar como quiser.
  • Licença maternidade estendida : mais tempo pra viver esse momento com tranquilidade.
  • Licença paternidade : presença garantida nos primeiros dias mais importantes.
  • Bônus : Atrelado ao atingimento de metas da Turbi e individuais.

Nosso jeito de trabalhar:

A Turbi é feita por gente real, que erra, aprende, cresce e faz acontecer. Por aqui, autonomia anda junto com responsabilidade. A gente valoriza um ambiente seguro pra falar o que pensa, construir com liberdade e ter conversas difíceis com respeito.

A gente valoriza pessoas que aprendem, se desafiam e querem gerar impacto de verdade.

Se viu aqui? Então se inscreve e vem com a gente transformar a mobilidade urbana!

title: AGENTE ESCOLAR - APOIO AO ALUNO- SÃO JOSÉ/SC

.

title: ADS Senior Consultant - Databricks Engineer
description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

Why to join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for a ADS Senior Consultant - Databricks Engineer, who wants to learn and transform his career.

Pipeline Operations, Governance, and Enablement

  • Excellent communication and coaching skills, with the ability to work in a fast‑paced, cross‑functional team.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills with high attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with team members.

Desirable Skills

  • Familiarity with Git‑based CI/CD for Databricks (Databricks Repos).
  • Pharmaceutical domain experience, including R&D data, clinical or preclinical workflows, and FAIR data principles.

title: Coordenador(a) de Operações - Atendimento, Tráfego e Produção
description:
Conteúdo digital de produtos | Presencial | São Paulo - Zona Sul | PJ

Compartilhe com seu amigo(a) que está em busca de um novo desafio!

A Retailbox está em crescimento e busca um(a) profissional para assumir a coordenação da operação depois que os projetos entram na casa.

Somos uma empresa de conteúdo digital para e-commerce e marketplaces. Atuamos na apresentação de produtos no ambiente digital, combinando fotografia, imagens, textos, contexto, organização de informações e método para ajudar marcas a venderem melhor online. Temos estúdio fotográfico próprio, equipe de criação, produção, logística e parceiros externos.

Esta pessoa será o elo entre cliente, operação interna e fornecedores. Depois que a área comercial fecha um projeto, ela assume o trabalho, organiza o briefing, estrutura as etapas, acompanha prazos, coordena a execução, cobra entregas, antecipa problemas e garante que o cliente receba o combinado com clareza, qualidade e consistência.

É uma posição para quem já viveu rotina de agência, atendimento, tráfego ou gestão de projetos - e sabe que uma boa entrega depende de organização, comunicação, cobrança e presença.

O que você vai fazer

  • Coordenar pessoas e processos.
  • Coordenar a entrada dos projetos após a venda.
  • Organizar briefings, prazos, prioridades e entregas.
  • Fazer interface direta com clientes durante a execução.
  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento e acompanhamento.
  • Manter comunicação com clientes em grupos de WhatsApp.
  • Distribuir demandas para a equipe interna.
  • Acompanhar fotógrafos, designers, logística, produção e fornecedores.
  • Controlar status de jobs, aprovações e pendências.
  • Cobrar materiais, respostas e entregas com firmeza e educação.
  • Identificar gargalos antes que virem problema.
  • Ajudar a melhorar processos, fluxos e organização da operação.
  • Garantir que cada projeto avance até a entrega final ao cliente.

O que buscamos

  • Capacidade e experiência em gestão de pessoas e processos.
  • Experiência anterior com atendimento, tráfego ou gestão de projetos em agência, produtora, operação criativa ou ambiente parecido.
  • Boa comunicação com clientes, equipe interna e fornecedores.
  • Maturidade para lidar com pressão, prazos e cobranças.
  • Postura responsável, estável e comprometida.
  • Autonomia para resolver problemas sem depender de microgestão.
  • Facilidade com planilhas.
  • Presença, clareza e senso de prioridade.

Este perfil provavelmente combina com você se

  • Você entende que prazo, alinhamento e follow-up fazem parte da entrega.
  • Você já trabalhou com cliente, equipe interna e produção ao mesmo tempo.
  • Você tem maturidade profissional e gosta de ser a pessoa que faz a operação andar.
  • Você quer uma posição de confiança, próxima da liderança.
  • Você quer fazer parte de um projeto inovador e com potencial.

Esta vaga pode não ser para você se

  • Você precisa receber instruções para cada pequena decisão.
  • Você tem dificuldade em cobrar retornos e entregas.
  • Você não gosta de lidar com cliente e equipe.
  • Você se perde quando há muitos projetos simultâneos.
  • Você prefere uma rotina muito previsível, sem pressão ou mudança de prioridade.
  • Você ainda está em fase inicial de carreira e precisa de acompanhamento constante.

Modelo de contratação

Presencial - São Paulo, Zona Sul

Segunda a sexta-feira

40 horas semanais

Contrato PJ

Remuneração: enviar pretensão

Sobre diversidade de trajetória

Valorizamos profissionais com trajetória sólida, maturidade profissional e experiência real em coordenação de operações. Esta oportunidade também é aberta e acolhedora para profissionais 40+ que queiram aplicar sua experiência em uma operação dinâmica de conteúdo digital para e-commerce.

title: Pessoa Analista de BI SR | Autorizações
description:

Com a missão de melhorar a vida das famílias brasileiras, dando acesso ao crédito e serviços financeiros inovadores, o Banco Carrefour é um dos maiores emissores de cartão de crédito do país, atendendo a milhões de brasileiros.

#bancocarrefour

  • Experiência em trabalhar com grandes conjuntos de dados (bases grandes) e processamento.
  • Capacidade de estruturar o raciocínio lógico e storytelling (Bom nível de Excel e Power Point)

  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em modelo flexível, com possibilidade de full home office.

  • Conhecimento em P&L (Lucros e Perdas) para entender as principais linhas e calcular ROI (Retorno sobre Investimento).
  • Experiência prévia no setor financeiro (principalmente vivência de cartão de crédito e/ou outros produtos bancários) ou ter atuado no segmento de varejo.

title: Senior Supply & Planning Manager - LATAM
description:

Senior Supply & Planning Manager – LATAM

Envu is proud to be Great Place to Work Certified in the U.S., France and India (June 2025 – June 2026)

FUNCTION : Senior Supply & Planning Manager - LATAM

LOCATION : São Paulo/ Brazil

JOB TYPE : Permanent

JOB GRADE : BR15

GET TO KNOW YOUR AREA:

  • Lead all Regional Demand planning & Supply activity to achieve the business objectives while meeting inventory targets and optimizing total costs of supply in compliance with quality and customer service expectations.
  • Lead regional short-, mid- and long-term demand and supply planning, balance, and execution, providing visibility on supply risks, mitigation plans, and supply opportunities.
  • Manage all materials planning and production planning for all tollers in Latin America, ensuring reliable, safe, and high-quality supply delivered on time.
  • Directly interface with Commercial Operations, Finance, and Regional Leadership to facilitate the monthly Sales, Inventory, and Operations Planning (SI&OP) cycle, ensuring that the information needed for business management is gathered and presented to support decision-making and maximize profitability.

YOUR MISSION WILL BE TO:

  • Lead the Demand Planning & Supply Team: recruitment, training, expertise, motivation, good practices, People development etc.
  • Integrated planning and decision making | Engage, collaborate and improve cross functional country and Regional SI&OP process, while translating regional sales demands into one integrated commercial-financial-supply plan. Additionally, along with Marketing & Sales, steer product launches, steer product allocations and manage product positioning at distribution. Be responsible for managing the demand forecast flow, optimizing stock levels & inventories and proposing solutions to balance appropriate stock levels and profitability
  • Orchestrate Regional supply planning process | Lead the supply planning process from short to long term, balancing costs and service level, through financial analysis to support decision making. Negotiate manufacturing capacity according to the business needs and optimize cost of goods
  • Demand and Supply Reconciliation | Lead the creation of constrained demand plan, agree and communicate product availability, with transparency and constructive discussions with stakeholders about tradeoffs involved. Work together with the Customer Service, Finance and internal clients such as Marketing and Sales, to generate feasible demand allocation plans for E2E SC coordination.
  • Drive inventory optimization strategies to enhance operational efficiency and reduce excess stock levels. Lead and implement inventory reduction initiatives, collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure optimal stock availability across the network. Maximize business outcomes by balancing inventory turnover with customer service levels, improving forecast alignment and replenishment decisions. Utilize data-driven insights and advanced analytics to monitor key performance indicators, support scenario-based decision-making, and continuously refine inventory management processes in line with regional strategic goals.
  • Optimize materials and production planning for external manufacturing operations. Developing and implementing efficient planning processes that ensure timely product availability while minimizing costs of goods sold. Collaborate closely with suppliers and manufacturing partners to align production schedules with demand forecasts, facilitating seamless operations and reducing lead times. Continuously assess and refine planning strategies, ensuring that inventory levels are maintained at optimal rates to meet customer needs without incurring unnecessary expenses.
  • Enable business & valuable customers experience I Ensure materials availability according to business & quality needs. Define and negotiate and adjust production priorities to deliver valuable customer experience.
  • SI&OP | Coordinate SI&OP and, performance KPI within the region. Provide necessary information on product availability to the commercial area, enabling best decision making and supply optimizations.

Planning Excellence | Foster planning excellence to optimize and continuously improve planning processes. Demonstrated ability to drive planning excellence through the implementation or optimization of tools such as o9 solutions, improving forecast accuracy and operational efficiency.

ARE YOU READY FOR THE ROLE?

Main requirements:

  • Degree, on Business Administration, Engineering or equivalent, MBA or Master in Supply chain Management preferred
  • APICS certification is a plus
  • 10 Years cumulative experience in different areas of Supply Chain. Previous experience in Planning / Inventory management
  • Key competencies | Customer Focus, Business Acumen, Strategic and Digital Mindset, Drives Results, Drives Vision & Purpose, Manages Ambiguity
  • Excellent multicultural communication, organization, influencing & coaching skills
  • Excellent knowledge of advanced planning principles, strategies, and systems (MS Dynamics 365 appreciated)
  • Fluent in Portuguese, English and Spanish

Envu is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants, regardless of ethnicity, color, race, religion, origin, age, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other conditions. And all opportunities are open to people with disabilities.

By applying for this position, you agree that your personal data are going to be processed and recorded by Envu for recruitment purposes only. For candidates who are not selected for this position, personal data will be kept for a period of two years and then permanently deleted.

title: Tech Lead - Ruby on Rails
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking an experienced and visionary Ruby on Rails Tech Lead to drive the technical direction of critical enterprise applications operating at a massive global scale. In this role, you will lead a high-performing engineering team focused on a complex and highly impactful domain: global electronic recyclables, inventory management, scheduling, transportation, and processing.

You will be at the forefront of designing and architecting robust, highly available web applications that integrate seamlessly across a vast internal ecosystem and with key external partners. Operating in an environment where performance, security, and scalability are non-negotiable, you will guide your team through complex technical challenges, ensuring our systems maintain uncompromising standards of data quality and integrity. If you thrive in a world-class engineering culture and have a passion for building sustainable, scalable solutions, this is the perfect opportunity to make a global impact.

Responsibilities

  • Technical Leadership: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of engineers, driving technical excellence, code quality, and best practices across the development lifecycle.
  • Architecture & Development: Lead the design, architecture, and feature development for existing and new scalable Ruby on Rails (Rails 6/7) applications.
  • System Optimization: Proactively troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to performance bottlenecks, response times, system capacity, and scalability limitations inherent in large-scale global ecosystems.
  • Complex Integrations: Architect and develop robust API integrations with 3rd-party vendors and a vast network of internal enterprise applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner closely with internal business stakeholders, global technology resources (database, systems, networking, security), and external vendors to deliver seamless end-to-end solutions.
  • Domain Ownership: Drive the technical execution for the electronic recyclables domain, encompassing inventory tracking, logistics, and processing workflows.
  • Quality & Documentation: Maintain rigorous data quality, integrity, and consistency across the organization. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation for architectures, workflows, and websites.
  • Full-Stack Oversight: While focusing heavily on backend architecture, oversee and contribute to front-end (GUI) integration and development to ensure a flawless user experience.

Required Qualifications

  • Proven Leadership: Solid, hands-on experience leading and managing technical teams in a large-scale, fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Ruby on Rails Mastery: 12+ years of overall software development experience, with a minimum of 10 years demonstrating expert-level knowledge of Ruby as a core language and the Ruby on Rails framework.
  • Advanced API Expertise: Extensive knowledge and practical experience in API design and interface technologies (JSON, ProtoBuf, REST, RPC, XML) at an enterprise scale.
  • Testing & CI/CD: Deep working knowledge of integrated testing frameworks (RSpec, MiniTest) and Continuous Integration suites (CircleCI, Jenkins) to maintain zero-downtime deployments and high code coverage.
  • Front-End Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of fundamental front-end development technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap, jQuery).
  • Education: 4-year degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or an equivalent rigorous technical training program/bootcamp.
  • Language: Fluent English, with excellent communication skills to articulate complex technical concepts to global, cross-functional stakeholders.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Go (Golang) Experience: Hands-on development experience with Go is highly desirable for specific microservices and performance-critical components.
  • Cloud Infrastructure: Experience deploying and scaling applications on AWS or similar enterprise cloud platforms.
  • Domain Knowledge: Previous experience working with supply chain, reverse logistics, inventory management, or sustainability/recycling systems.
  • Big Tech Experience: Prior experience working within the ecosystem of a massive, global technology company, understanding the nuances of enterprise-grade security, compliance, and global rollouts.

title: Coordenador de Inteligência Antifraude (Patrimonial)
description:
Descrição da vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Coordenador(a) de Security Services para liderar e estruturar serviços especializados de segurança corporativa/ inteligência antifraude, atuando de forma estratégica na coordenação de equipes, consultorias, análises de riscos e proteção de ativos para diferentes clientes.

Essa posição combina atuação técnica, liderança de pessoas e visão sistêmica de processos de segurança e inteligência Antifraude.

Conheça nossa história:

A nossa história começa em 1994, na Argentina, quando a GIF se estabeleceu como fornecedora estratégica para empresas. Na mesma época, houve uma expansão comercial significativa, que foi acompanhada por um aumento de casos de fraudes. Foi nesse momento que a assumimos a responsabilidade de garantir a segurança das empresas e entramos em ação.

Ao longo desses quase 30 anos, a GIF tem trabalhado incansavelmente na prevenção, detecção e combate às fraudes corporativas. Uma história marcada por confiança, dedicação, colaboração, transparência e respeito.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Coordenar equipes responsáveis por investigações, consultoria em security services e proteção de ativos;
  • Revisar, consolidar e emitir relatórios técnicos, executivos e pareceres;
  • Diligenciar para obtenção de materialidade a partir de metodologia OSINT e Integração com forças públicas;

title: Cloud Platform Engineer Sr
description:
O Itaú é a marca mais valiosa do Brasil, a melhor empresa para trabalhar segundo o Great Place to Work e o maior banco da América Latina. Nós impactamos diariamente mais de 98 milhões de clientes em 18 países.

Somos feitos de pessoas e acreditamos que ter um time com pluralidade de origens, culturas, crenças, experiências, raças, deficiências, gêneros, orientações afetivo-sexuais e gerações ampliam as perspectivas e contribuem para um clima de respeito e valorização das diferenças.

Estamos buscando uma pessoa para a posição de Cloud Platform Engineer , que queira se desenvolver e aprender, compartilhar, colaborar e inovar, entregando valor para todos os nossos clientes.

Atuação na região Central - Polo CTO no modelo hibrido

Nessa função você vai:

No Itaú, as plataformas de IA e GenAI já operam em escala real, suportando modelos fundacionais, agentes autônomos, pipelines de inferência e workloads intensivos em computação.

O grande desafio da nossa squad é claro:

Reduzir o Time-to-Market de projetos de Dados, IA e Inovação, garantindo plataformas cloud robustas, seguras, eficientes e automatizadas, prontas para suportar alta demanda de compute, dados sensíveis e integrações complexas.

Essa vaga é para quem quer atuar no core da engenharia de plataformas de IA construindo a infraestrutura que viabiliza LLMs, agentes e RAG em produção com confiabilidade, observabilidade e controle de custos.

Ser a pessoa engenheira responsável por habilitar os recursos necessários para provisionamento de plataformas de IA, como recursos e serviços em Cloud garantindo que times de produto consigam colocar soluções de IA em produção com velocidade e segurança.

Aqui, cloud não é apenas infraestrutura. É plataforma de aceleração de IA.

Como Cloud é tratado aqui / Cloud não é tratado como:

  • Provisionamento manual
  • Ambientes isolados por projeto
  • Infraestrutura estática
  • Cloud aqui é:
  • Padronizada e reutilizável
  • Infraestrutura como codigo, desde o design
  • Base para workloads de IA escaláveis e observáveis
  • Fundamento para custo eficiente em compute intensivo

O que você vai construir

  • Plataformas cloud para IA e GenAI, suportando:
  • LLMs, agentes autônomos, RAG e pipelines de inferência
  • Ambientes de treino, experimentação e produção
  • Arquiteturas cloud escaláveis e resilientes, cobrindo:
  • AWS, Azure e/ou GCP
  • Ambientes híbridos e multi-cloud
  • Ambientes containerizados e orquestrados:
  • Docker e Kubernetes (EKS/AKS/GKE)
  • oIngress controllers, service mesh e load balancing L4/L7
  • Infraestrutura como Codigo (IaC):
  • Terraform e CloudFormation
  • Padrões reutilizáveis e versionados
  • Pipelines CI/CD e automação:
  • Deploy de aplicações, modelos e infra
  • Integração com fluxos de MLOps / AIOps
  • Observabilidade completa de plataformas de IA:
  • Monitoramento, logging, tracing
  • Troubleshooting de workloads distribuídos
  • Otimização de custos em IA (FinOps):
  • Compute intensivo (GPU/CPU)

title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Piece

Piece is a holding company that acquires vertical software/AI businesses and scales them through creator-powered distribution. We believe the next Latin American giants will emerge at the intersection of AI and creator economy — software brings technology, recurring revenue, and LTV; creators bring audience, trust, and distribution. Piece brings them together.

Our edge is a proprietary creator-focused distribution engine that uses AI to automate growth across our vertical software portfolio — social media, sales funnels, content, and creator operations. Every vertical we add makes the machine smarter, compounding proprietary data on what works in creator-led distribution for AI/Software. Our goal is to hit US$10M ARR in 2026.

We're building Piece to be a home for some of the most exceptional people in the world. Talent density is non-negotiable, the bar is unreasonably high, and we expect excellence in everything we ship. Our ambition is to put Brazil on the map as a global protagonist in growth and distribution.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to be the technical pillar of the product at the first and main company in our portfolio — someone who combines technical depth with product sense, and who will own the architecture, evolution, and operation of its entire backend and AI infrastructure.

You'll be hands-on building and scaling the systems that orchestrate our agents, process messages in real time, and sustain the platform's accelerated growth. This isn't a maintenance role — it's a building role.

If you enjoy solving complex problems in distributed systems, have a genuine interest in applied AI, and want to build something that's reshaping how the Brazilian legal market operates, this is the place. You'll join as part of our founding team, with competitive compensation and meaningful equity through stock options.

What you'll do

Backend architecture and evolution

  • Design and evolve the microservices that power the platform, with a focus on scalability and maintainability
  • Make technical decisions autonomously — database modeling, API design, stack choices
  • Raise the team's technical bar through code review and mentorship

AI agents and LLMs

  • Build and evolve our agent pipelines: orchestration, tool calling, dynamic workflows, and intelligent routing
  • Optimize cost and latency of LLM calls without compromising quality
  • Evolve our RAG, document processing, and voice synthesis features

Integrations and operations

  • Ensure reliability of asynchronous message flows and external integrations
  • Build new integrations as the product evolves
  • Maintain operational stability in a multi-tenant system with paying customers

Quality and observability

  • Ensure end-to-end traceability across synchronous and asynchronous flows
  • Structure operational metrics and maintain visibility over agent behavior in production
  • Identify and resolve performance bottlenecks before they become incidents

What we expect from you

Backend & Systems

  • Proficiency with Node.js + TypeScript in high-throughput production systems — including API design, modular architecture, and long-term maintainability decisions
  • Strong grasp of event-driven and asynchronous architectures: message queues, pub/sub patterns, idempotency, retry logic, and failure isolation in distributed systems
  • Experience designing multi-tenant SaaS backends: data isolation strategies, per-tenant configuration, and operational complexity at scale
  • Solid database modeling — relational (schema design, indexing, query optimization) and NoSQL (document modeling, consistency trade-offs) — and ability to choose the right store for the problem
  • Hands-on cloud experience (GCP preferred): Cloud Run, Pub/Sub, Firestore/Cloud SQL, IAM, and observability tooling

AI & Agent Systems

  • Experience building LLM-powered pipelines in production — not just calling APIs, but thinking through orchestration, context management, fallback behavior, and output reliability
  • Understanding of agent architectures: tool calling, multi-step reasoning, routing logic, state management across turns, and how to make agents predictable in real-world conditions
  • Practical knowledge of RAG pipelines: chunking strategies, embedding selection, retrieval quality, and reranking — and awareness of where RAG breaks down
  • Cost and latency awareness in LLM usage: prompt engineering for efficiency, model selection trade-offs, caching strategies, and when not to use an LLM
  • Familiarity with evaluation and observability for AI systems: how to measure agent quality, detect regressions, and maintain visibility over non-deterministic behavior in production

Product & Technical Judgment

  • Ability to reason about product trade-offs, not just technical ones — understands what to build, what to cut, and why
  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity: capable of going from a fuzzy problem to a concrete technical proposal without needing a fully-specced ticket
  • Has opinions about prioritization and isn't just an executor — questions requirements upstream and thinks about user and business impact before writing the first line of code
  • Uses AI tools natively in the development workflow (coding assistants, automated testing, code review, documentation) and stays current with the evolving tooling landscape. Understands that development velocity is a competitive advantage, not just an output metric

Quality & Operational Maturity

  • Ability to instrument distributed systems end-to-end: structured logging, distributed tracing, alerting, and SLO thinking
  • Experience operating asynchronous flows with real customers: understanding of what breaks silently and how to catch it before they do
  • Comfort with ambiguity — able to define the right technical approach when the problem itself is still being figured out

Nice to have

  • Python for ML/data pipelines or LLM experimentation
  • Go for latency-critical or high-throughput services
  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, RLHF, or systematic model evaluation
  • Background in regulated or compliance-heavy domains (legaltech, fintech)

What we offer

  • Founding team seat — real ownership of what gets built and how
  • Competitive compensation
  • Meaningful stock options
  • On-site environment with high talent density and direct exposure to founders

Details

  • Work model: On-site (São Paulo or São José dos Campos)
  • Availability: Full-time
  • Contract: PJ

title: Finance Manager
description:
Finance Manager

Location: Fully Remote (LATAM)

Job Type: Full-Time

Strong financial operations don’t just track performance, they drive it. We’re looking for a Finance Manager who can take ownership of our accounting and financial processes, improve reporting speed and accuracy, and support operational decision-making as we scale.

About Uproot Clean

Uproot Clean is a fast-growing, performance-driven consumer brand built for pet owners. We operate across ecommerce and retail, and our finance function plays a critical role in enabling smart, data-driven growth.

We believe finance should be proactive, structured, and tightly connected to operations. That’s where you come in.

The Role

This is an ownership role. You will manage the full accounting cycle, oversee financial reporting, and ensure accuracy across all financial operations.

You will work closely with the VP of Operations and play a key role in improving processes, shortening close cycles, and building a scalable finance function.

This is not a purely back-office role, you’ll be expected to think analytically, identify inefficiencies, and actively improve how we operate.

This Role Is For You If:

  • You think in systems and processes, not just tasks
  • You are detail-oriented and highly organized
  • You are comfortable owning the full accounting cycle
  • You enjoy improving workflows and increasing efficiency
  • You can balance accuracy with speed in a fast-paced environment

This Role Is NOT For You If:

  • You prefer narrowly defined tasks without ownership
  • You struggle with deadlines or process improvement
  • You are not comfortable working in a high-growth environment

What You'll Do

Accounting & Financial Operations

  • Own the full accounting cycle, including month-end close
  • Prepare financial statements and reports
  • Ensure accuracy and compliance across financial records

Month-End Close & Process Improvement

  • Reduce month-end close timeline from 5 days to 3 days
  • Identify inefficiencies and improve accounting workflows
  • Build scalable processes and documentation

Team Oversight

  • Manage and oversee the bookkeeping team and AP clerk
  • Ensure quality, accuracy, and timeliness of work

Cost & Inventory Accounting

  • Manage and apply landed costs across products
  • Ensure accurate cost tracking and margin visibility

Reporting & Analysis

  • Provide financial insights and analysis to support decision-making
  • Work closely with the VP of Operations on performance tracking

Requirements

Must have:

  • 1+ year of experience in ecommerce or DTC
  • Experience managing full accounting cycle and financial reporting
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and organization

Work Requirements

⏰ Schedule: Flexble

Workspace: Fixed, professional setup required (stable internet + backup plan)

Benefits & Compensation

  • Fully remote
  • Paid time off
  • Flex days. Enjoy an extra quarterly day off to unwind and recharge energies whenever you desire
  • Ownership & autonomy - trusted to build and execute strategy

Ready to Apply?

If you want to build and scale a high-performing finance function, apply now.

title: Product Designer
description:
THE OPPORTUNITY

At Busbud, we connect millions of travelers with buses, coaches, and trains across 80+ countries. Design is how we make that feel effortless.

As a Product Designer, you’ll sit at the intersection of design, technology, and business, turning complex ideas into intuitive, well-crafted experiences that solve real problems for real people. You won’t just be designing the experience; you’ll be an active partner in defining it. You’ll focus on consolidating and elevating our web experience across our family of brands (Busbud, Buson, Recorrido, and more), working in a tight-knit team of two designers and reporting to the Lead Product Designer.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

  • End-to-End Ownership: Drive the full design lifecycle, from early-stage exploration and concept development to final hand-off and implementation.
  • Strategic Problem Solving: Partner with Product Managers and Engineers to define problems, translate business goals into design solutions, and ensure technical feasibility.
  • Craft & Execution: Leverage our robust design system to move directly from concept to high-fidelity execution, bypassing low-fidelity wireframing to prioritize speed and visual precision.
  • Iterative Design: Use data, user research, and performance metrics to continuously refine the product, moving fluidly between exploration and execution.
  • System Thinking: Contribute to and evolve our design systems to ensure a scalable, consistent, and efficient experience across the entire product.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

  • Foundational Excellence: 5+ years of experience in product or UX design, with a portfolio that demonstrates the ability to simplify complex problems with strong visual craft.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Experience working in cross-functional environments where you can communicate design decisions and storytell the vision to engineers, PMs, and leadership.
  • Technical Proficiency: Mastery of Figma and a solid understanding of scalable design practices, with fluency in English (written and spoken).
  • Quality & Autonomy: An obsessive attention to detail and the ability to own your time and priorities without hand-holding. We don’t believe in micromanagement.

Additional Assets

  • Experience with design systems and multi-brand product families.
  • Visual or graphic design skills.
  • Basic front-end knowledge (HTML/CSS).
  • Motion design or micro-interaction experience.

THE IMPACT YOU’LL HAVE

Your work will directly influence the daily experience of millions of travelers, driving satisfaction and overall product success. By balancing user empathy with business objectives, you’ll help us build products that are both meaningful and highly functional.

  • Intuitive solutions that align with user needs and ship on time.
  • A maintainable, scalable design system that empowers the whole team.
  • Consistent, high-quality experiences that support our long-term business goals.

title: Designer Gráfico — Consultoria em Negócios Jurídicos B2B
description:
Sobre a Javali

A Javali é uma consultoria de negócios jurídicos. Ajudamos escritórios de advocacia empresarial a crescerem com estratégia, conteúdo e posicionamento. Não somos agência de marketing. Trabalhamos lado a lado com sócios de escritórios que faturam milhões e precisam de inteligência de mercado para se diferenciar e não apenas de posts bonitos para Instagram.

Somos um time pequeno, com profundidade alta no mercado. Nossos clientes são exigentes, trabalhamos temas sofisticados, com impacto visual visível. Quem entra aqui tem autonomia real e responsabilidade proporcional.

Esta vaga combina com você se…

• Você quer executar dentro de um padrão visual já definido, com agilidade e atenção a detalhes e não esteja procurando posição para liderar direção criativa ou comandar equipe.

• Você é designer gráfico aplicado a marketing, com experiência em criação de peças de redes sociais, e-books, apresentações comerciais e não está em transição para UX/UI ou Product Design.

• Você domina as ferramentas certas para cada entrega, sem fanatismo. Se você acredita que "ferramenta X é a única séria" e não usa o resto, você vai se frustar aqui.

• Você tem ao menos 1 ano de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer ou ainda fez um estágio único de 12+ meses contínuos com responsabilidades reais. Aqui você vai aplicar o que já sabe;

• Sua estética é corporativa, institucional, sóbria. Se seu portfólio mostra cuidado com hierarquia, clareza e linguagem visual profissional, vai casar bem.

O que você vai fazer
  • Produção diária de peças gráficas para uma carteira de clientes (escritórios de advocacia). O trabalho é volume com qualidade dentro de padrão.
  • Peças para redes sociais (50% do tempo). Posts, stories, carrosséis e capas para LinkedIn (principal canal B2B jurídico) e Instagram. Você adapta a partir de templates e diretrizes visuais já definidas para cada cliente. Não é criação do zero o tempo todo. É execução inteligente dentro de um padrão.
  • Diagramação de materiais (30% do tempo). E-books de 30+ páginas, apresentações comerciais, propostas, newsletters, relatórios e materiais institucionais. Conteúdo chega pronto ou semi-pronto. Seu papel é transformar texto denso em layouts limpos. Clareza e ritmo de leitura importam mais do que efeito visual.
  • Adaptações e desdobramentos (15% do tempo). Adaptar peças entre formatos e plataformas, ajustar materiais existentes, criar variações a partir de um key visual aprovado.
  • Organização de arquivos (5% do tempo). Manter pastas organizadas, nomear arquivos corretamente, respeitar padrões de entrega. Parte do método.
Stack esperada
  • Base sólida: Photoshop e Illustrator em nível intermediário a avançado (tratamento de imagem, vetorização, ajustes finos).
  • Produção ágil: familiaridade com ferramentas de criação rápida para volume de social e materiais simples (Canva Pro, Figma ou equivalentes).
  • Apresentações: PowerPoint ou Google Slides para institucional e comercial.
  • Diferencial real: InDesign para diagramação editorial densa, motion (After Effects, CapCut), IA generativa aplicada a design, experiência prévia em mercado jurídico, financeiro ou serviços profissionais.
Requisitos não negociáveis

1 a 5 anos de experiência efetiva (CLT ou PJ) como designer gráfico

• Portfólio acessível (link de Behance, Dribbble, site pessoal ou PDF)

• Capacidade de trabalhar com volume, múltiplos clientes e prazos curtos sem perder qualidade

• Atenção a detalhes: revisão de textos nas peças, alinhamentos, consistência entre formatos

• Disponibilidade para híbrido em SP (presencial 3x/semana na região do Paraíso)

• Aceita contratação PJ

Processo seletivo

Triagem por currículo + portfólio · Entrevista · Teste prático visual · Conversa final.

O que oferecemos

• Contrato PJ com remuneração compatível com o mercado

• Modelo híbrido (presencial em SP, 3x por semana + remoto)

• Autonomia real: você terá clientes e entregas sob sua responsabilidade

• Exposição a um nicho de alta complexidade e alto valor — negócios jurídicos é um mercado que você dificilmente encontra em outro lugar

• Espaço para crescer. Quem entra e entrega, evolui rápido.

title: LP Partnership Manager (LATAM)
description:
We are looking for an LP Partnership Manager (LATAM) to drive business development and build strong relationships with liquidity providers across Latin America. This role will be instrumental in sourcing, onboarding, and managing LP partners throughout the region, while working closely with the trading team to optimize liquidity, pricing, and execution.

The ideal candidate is deeply embedded within the LATAM financial ecosystem, with a strong network of regional liquidity providers, banks, payment processors, OTC desks, and institutional partners. They should possess a strong understanding of local market structures, FX and payment flows, regulatory nuances, and banking infrastructure across key LATAM corridors.

Key Responsibilities:

Business Development & Partnerships

  • Identify, source, and establish relationships with local and regional liquidity providers across LATAM
  • Evaluate LP quality including pricing, depth, reliability, settlement capabilities, and regional coverage
  • Negotiate trading terms including spreads, fees, credit lines, settlement arrangements, and margin terms
  • Build strategic partnerships with local banks, payment providers, OTC desks, and institutional counterparties

Market & Network Development

  • Leverage an existing LATAM network to expand LP coverage across key markets including Brazil, Mexico, Argentina, Colombia, Chile, and other emerging corridors
  • Maintain strong relationships with regional banks, payment providers, FX brokers, and liquidity partners
  • Stay up to date with local market dynamics, regulatory developments, FX controls, pricing trends, and competitive landscape across LATAM
  • Provide local market intelligence and operational insight to support regional expansion and corridor development

Execution & Collaboration

  • Work closely with traders to ensure optimal liquidity, pricing, execution quality, and settlement efficiency for LATAM flows
  • Coordinate with internal compliance, operations, treasury, and onboarding teams to ensure smooth LP integration and operational setup
  • Support ongoing performance monitoring, optimization, and expansion of LP relationships across the region
  • Assist in identifying new liquidity opportunities tied to stablecoin adoption and cross-border payment demand in LATAM

Banking & Infrastructure Setup

  • Facilitate the opening of local bank accounts and establishment of payment rails required for LP operations in LATAM markets
  • Identify suitable banking and payment partners to support local currency settlement, cross-border flows, and fiat-to-stablecoin conversion
  • Support infrastructure setup for regional treasury operations, local collections, and payout capabilities

Requirements

  • 5 to 10 years of experience in business development, partnerships, liquidity management, or institutional sales
  • Strong experience in payments, FX, trading, digital assets, or related financial services
  • Deep understanding of LATAM financial markets, local banking systems, payment infrastructure, and regional liquidity dynamics
  • Well connected with liquidity providers, banks, OTC desks, payment processors, and institutional partners across LATAM
  • Proven ability to source, onboard, and manage LPs within local LATAM markets
  • Strong knowledge of cross-border payment corridors, local currency settlement, and regional regulatory considerations
  • Must have a strong and established LP network in Latin America, with particular strength in one or more major regional markets
  • Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese is highly preferred

Vision & Mission

OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement, and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain’s “killer app,” with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption.

The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners, and cross-border corridors.

OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda, and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia, and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion.

As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto, payments, and emerging market infrastructure to join us in shaping compliant, global payment rails for the next generation of cross-border finance.

title: Account Manager Team Lead
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!

ABOUT THE ROLE

The mission of the Account Manager Team Lead at SHEIN is to drive sustainable growth for partner brands and sellers by leading and developing the Account Management team, delivering data-driven insights, and strengthening strategic relationships. This role ensures operational excellence across campaigns, assortments, and portfolio management, while maximizing revenue opportunities and elevating product quality and commercial performance within SHEIN’s BR marketplace. As a people leader, the Team Lead also supports team development, fosters high performance, and ensures alignment with business goals and marketplace strategy.

This role will be based in our office in São Paulo/Faria Lima.

Responsabilities:

  • Responsible for leveraging GMV for all managed sellers they assist in order to guarantee their best portfolio.
  • Lead business development for the category of Fashion Accessories
  • Manage the team of Account Managers for the category, providing guidance, training, and support to ensure optimal performance.
  • Monitor and control basic account performance metrics (SKCs, sales, traffic and conversion)
  • Negotiate strategies to leverage seller performance.
  • Prepare reports about assisted sellers to leadership in order to execute defined strategies.
  • Ensure high-quality service and maintain strong relationships with sellers.
  • Propose and execute category/seller-growth projects.
  • Be responsible for supporting the training and onboarding of new team members, acting as a technical reference and contributing to the team’s ongoing development.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree. Preference in Business, Engineering, International Relations or related areas
  • Experience in e-commerce/marketplaces
  • Prior experience in Project Management is a plus
  • Prior experience in fashion market is a plus
  • Excellent communication skills — written and verbal — in Portuguese and English (Advanced/Fluent)
  • Advanced MS Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).

At SHEIN, we believe that diversity is the force that drives innovation. We are committed to creating an environment where all voices are heard, valued and respected. All our vacancies are inclusive for people with disabilities, women, black people, LGBTQIAPN+ community and all types of diversity.

Com 100 mil colaboradores atuando em mais de 100 países - e interconectados pela plataforma de IA Marcel -, somos um parceiro estratégico no processo de transformação de nossos clientes. A pessoa Supervisora de Mídia será responsável por liderar a execução e a operação de campanhas de mídia integradas, atuando de forma híbrida entre digital e off. Informações adicionais

Todas as nossas vagas são abertas a pessoas de todas as identidades de gênero, orientações afetivas, raças, etnias, idades, religiões, pessoas com deficiência, entre outras. Acreditamos que equipes diversas constroem soluções mais criativas e humanas.

⚕️Plataforma virtual de acesso a médicos e especialistas

Telepsicologia e acompanhamento nutricional

Nosso compromisso com você

No Publicis Groupe, acreditamos que o sucesso começa com pessoas bem cuidadas, ouvidas e inspiradas. Aqui, nos preocupamos com a sua jornada, por isso, trazemos alguns dos pilares que sustentam nossa cultura:

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil

Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.G., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data;
    partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don't meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable businessteams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks;
    contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience withETL processes and/or tools (e.G., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience withSiebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

About Encora

Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world's leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora's technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.

At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

Esta é uma posição estratégica, com forte exposição à alta liderança, atuando tanto na consolidação da operação atual quanto na construção da visão comercial de médio e longo prazo.

O cargo exige forte capacidade de conduzir negociações complexas, relacionamento direto com clientes de alto poder aquisitivo, investidores e decisores, além de equilíbrio entre estratégia, inteligência comercial, atuação digital e presença ativa no relacionamento presencial.

Suas principais responsabilidades

  • Analisar mercado, comportamento de consumo de clientes de luxo, tendências e oportunidades;
  • Atuar estrategicamente junto à liderança, com visão financeira, leitura de negócios e impacto em resultados;
  • Representar institucionalmente a área comercial em interações críticas com clientes e parceiros estratégicos;
  • Preparar o canal para crescimento sustentado, com visão de longo prazo e sucessão.

Perfil desejado

  • Experiência sólida em posições de liderança comercial sênior, com atendimento direto a clientes de alto padrão, UHNW ou investidores;
  • Forte vivência em negociações complexas, de alto valor agregado, envolvendo múltiplas variáveis e tomada de decisão consultiva;
  • Histórico em segmentos como mercado financeiro, investimentos, luxo ou real estate estruturado;
  • Capacidade comprovada de atuar em ambientes de reestruturação, crescimento e profissionalização comercial;
  • Excelente leitura de perfil de cliente, capacidade de adaptação de discurso e construção de relacionamento de longo prazo;
  • Boa interação com marketing, entendendo posicionamento de marca, proposta de valor e jornada do cliente;
  • Perfil maduro, autônomo, atualizado em tendências digitais, dados, IA e comportamento de consumo, sem perder o "corpo a corpo";
  • Comunicação sofisticada, presença executiva e capacidade de representar a companhia em contextos estratégicos;
  • Visão financeira e de negócios, com entendimento de rentabilidade, fluxo e lógica de investimento;
  • Experiência prévia em empresas estruturadas será considerada um diferencial relevante.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Formação superior completa;
  • Experiência consistente em liderança de times comerciais;
  • Experiência comprovada com clientes de alto padrão e vendas consultivas complexas;
  • Disponibilidadepara atuação 100% presencial;
  • Local de trabalho: Zona Leste de São Paulo.

O que você obterá em troca

A oportunidade de assumir uma posição estratégica, com forte protagonismo, exposição à alta liderança e impacto direto na construção do futuro comercial da companhia.

O cargo oferece um pacote competitivo, com fixo e variável atrelado ao resultado do canal como um todo, além de benefícios alinhados a posições executivas. Trata-se de uma porta de entrada para uma trajetória sólida e de longo prazo, em uma empresa em clara evolução de maturidade e governança.

title: Merchant Experience Manager
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to transform food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage. Our story began in 2023 in Hong Kong, China, where we became an industry leader in under a year. Building on that momentum, we entered Saudi Arabia in 2024 and soon expanded to over 20 cities. This year, we accelerated further, launching in Qatar, Kuwait, and the UAE within a remarkable 40-day span. Now, we've just launched in Brazil, through a pilot in Santos and São Vicente, with more destinations ahead.

What You'll Do

1. Improve Core Merchant Experience:

  • Analyze root causes of cancellations
  • Define and execute structured action plans
  • Partner with Product, Ops, and CS to implement structural fixes -
  • Build dashboards and monitor performance impact

2. Lead Peak & Special Event Operations

  • Develop operational playbooks for key periods (Christmas, Carnival, World Cup)
  • Identify high-risk cohorts and mitigate operational risks
  • Ensure stable performance during demand spikes

3. Solve High-Impact Structural Issues

  • Improve experience for key accounts
  • Review and refine refund & liability policies
  • Drive cross-functional alignment to reduce recurring issues

4. Drive Merchant Performance Programs

  • Develop and scale the Super/Top Restaurant Program
  • Create structured performance tiers
  • Launch initiatives to improve merchant health and unlock GMV

5. Enhance Merchant Platform Experience

  • Identify friction points in merchant tools
  • Propose improvements to increase self-service
  • Reduce operational dependency on manual support

What We Need From You

  • Required
  • Demonstrated experience in operations, marketplace, consulting, or similar environments
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills -
  • Experience leading cross-functional initiatives -
  • Data-driven mindset -
  • Strong stakeholder management -
  • Fluent English

2. Preferred

  • Experience in food delivery or marketplace platforms
  • Experience building performance or incentive programs
  • Exposure to product/platform improvement projects

What Makes This Role Exciting

  • Opportunity to shape Merchant Experience in a fast-growing international platform
  • High visibility with leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Direct impact on core company KPIs
  • Exposure to international HQ and global strategy
  • Opportunity to build scalable frameworks from an early stage.

Why Join Keeta

Power Global Delivery to Transform Communities: As the driving force behind Meituan's global expansion, Keeta is delivering more than just food and goods, but real impact too. We believe in growth that lifts everyone: our people, our partners, and the communities we serve. With deep insights into global markets and a commitment to local innovation, we're uniquely positioned to seize high-growth opportunities while helping people eat better and live better.

Break Through Borders, Grow Without Bounds: With Keeta's global reach, your potential has no borders. You'll navigate diverse markets and cultures, developing both a global mindset and local expertise. Every project challenges you to create solutions that resonate worldwide, taking the business and your career further than you could imagine.

Team Up to Outthink and Outdeliver: At Keeta, you'll work with a team that thrives on collaboration. We tackle challenges head-on, driven by a shared determination to deliver results. Open debate and bold ideas are encouraged—because great solutions emerge when perspectives converge. With teammates from over 40 countries, we outthink the expected and outdeliver the exceptional.

Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente!

Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!

Sólida experiência em desenvolvimento Java e Kotlin:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde;

Horário Flexível;
Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

Então essa é a sua chance!

  • Conhecimento de desenvolvimento em ADF (Azure Data Factory).
  • Power BI.
  • Conhecimento em Javascript.
  • Conhecimento em algum framework (Bootstrap, React, JQuery, etc.).
  • Conhecimento em práticas DevOps (teste automatizado, containers, integração contínua e deploy contínuo).

Idiomas:

  • Espanhol – desejável nível básico.
  • Inglês – fundamental nível intermediário para conversação.

O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias

  • Convênio com empresas parceiras

    Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua

Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!

No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Especialista Jurídico Imobiliário
description:
Comércio varejista de grande porte contrata Especialista Jurídico Imobiliário.

Esse profissional atuará na assessoria jurídica estratégica da área imobiliária da empresa, com foco em transações imobiliárias de grande porte, tais como locações, compra e venda, reestruturações, processos regulatórios e compliance, além de garantir a conformidade com as exigências legais específicas para empresas de capital aberto.

Responsabilidades:

  • Consultoria Jurídica Imobiliária: Assessoria em transações imobiliárias, incluindo aquisições, vendas, locações, incorporações e desenvolvimento de novos projetos imobiliários.
  • Due Diligence e Negociação de Contratos: Condução de processos de due diligence, elaboração e revisão de contratos imobiliários, controle de prazos de locação, com objetivo de assegurar que todas as condições contratuais atendam aos interesses da empresa e estejam em conformidade com a legislação vigente.
  • Gestão de Riscos: Identificação e mitigação de riscos jurídicos relacionados a ativos imobiliários, com ênfase em aspectos regulatórios e financeiros, especialmente considerando as exigências de uma empresa de capital aberto.
  • Compliance e Governança: Garantir que todas as operações imobiliárias estejam em conformidade com as regulamentações da Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM), da B3 e de outras entidades reguladoras pertinentes.
  • Estratégia Corporativa: Colaboração com as áreas de expansão, financeira e executiva, oferecendo suporte jurídico para decisões estratégicas envolvendo ativos imobiliários.
  • Representação da Empresa: Apoiar ou representar a empresa em litígios e negociações de disputas imobiliárias, em juízo ou fora dele, buscando soluções rápidas e eficientes, efetuar o controle para ingresso de ações renovatórias ou revisionais;
  • Atualização Regulatória: Acompanhamento contínuo das mudanças legislativas e regulamentares no setor imobiliário e sua aplicação prática no contexto corporativo.

Qualificações e Requisitos:

  • Formação Acadêmica: Graduação em Direito, com especialização (Lato Sensu ou Stricto Sensu) em Direito Imobiliário, Empresarial, ou áreas correlatas.

title: Technical Solution Manager (Energy Storage)
description:
Key Responsibilities

1. Solution Design & Optimization

- Lead the design of energy storage solutions across grid-side, generation-side (renewable + storage), and standalone/shared energy storage power stations

- Develop integrated system solutions covering PCS, EMS, BMS, and substation systems

- Analyze grid dispatch requirements and technical challenges in renewable grid integration

2. Tendering & Bidding Support

- Take the lead in large-scale energy storage project tenders

- Prepare technical proposals, including equipment selection, system topology design, and technical deviation analysis

- Ensure compliance, competitiveness, and technical excellence of proposals

3. Customized Project Development

- Evaluate system integration solutions for utility-scale storage projects

- Conduct electrical calculations and simulation analysis for various applications (frequency regulation, peak shaving, black start, etc.)

- Support sales teams in cost estimation and pricing strategy at project level

4. Full Lifecycle Technical Management

- Support project execution from design through construction and delivery

- Resolve technical issues related to electrical interfaces, communication protocols, and grid integration

- Provide technical support during operation & maintenance phases

5. Policy & Market Insights

- Track regional energy storage policies (capacity compensation, spot market rules, grid connection requirements, etc.)

- Analyze market dynamics and regional characteristics

- Contribute to white papers and technical roadmap reports for grid-side energy storage

6. Project Development Enablement

- Develop technical documentation such as:

- Utility-scale ESS development guidelines

- Grid connection FAQs

- Delivery & acceptance SOPs

- Deliver technical training to sales and project teams to accelerate commercialization

7. Competitive Analysis

- Benchmark leading competitors (e.G., Sungrow, HyperStrong)

- Conduct SWOT analysis and provide strategic insights

- Support product evolution in areas such as high-voltage cascade systems and liquid cooling technologies

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in Power Systems, Electrical Engineering, High Voltage Engineering, or related fields

- Minimum 3+ years of experience in the energy storage industry

- Proven experience supporting utility-scale (100MWh+) energy storage projects is preferred

Technical Expertise

- Strong knowledge of primary and secondary electrical design for energy storage systems

- Familiarity with protection systems, grid compliance testing, and SCADA/communication protocols

- Experience with power system analysis;
proficiency in simulation tools such as PSCAD or ETAP is a plus

Soft Skills

- Strong cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills

- Ability to represent the company in technical reviews with grid operators, EPCs, and clients

Documentation Skills

- Excellent technical writing skills with the ability to produce structured, high-quality proposals and reports

title: Especialista De Remuneração
description:
A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 15 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 4 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.

MISSÃO DO CARGO

Atuar como referência técnica em remuneração, liderando o desenvolvimento, a análise e a aplicação de políticas e práticas corporativas relacionadas a cargos, salários e remuneração variável. Contribuir estrategicamente para a gestão do orçamento de pessoal e estrutura organizacional, oferecendo suporte técnico qualificado às lideranças, conduzindo análises complexas e promovendo soluções que garantam competitividade externa, equilíbrio interno e sustentabilidade financeira, em conformidade com as diretrizes da empresa e os requisitos legais.

RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Atuar como referência técnica (key-user) dos sistemas de remuneração e estrutura organizacional, apoiando a implantação de novas soluções, melhorias sistêmicas e integrações com outras plataformas de RH;
  • Liderar o cicloorçamentário de pessoal da Holding, assegurando a coerência dos dados, a consistência entre as unidades e a precisão nos impactos financeiros e organizacionais;
  • Conduzir reuniões consultivas com gestores e alta liderança, avaliando impactos técnicos e financeiros de decisões de movimentações ou reorganizações, propondo soluções sustentáveis e alinhadas à política corporativa;
  • Apoiar a implantação das ações aprovadas em comitês estratégicos, elaborando simulações, relatórios gerenciais e documentos de suporte à tomada de decisão;
  • Atuar no desenho e implementação de programas de remuneração variável e incentivos, assegurando a conformidade com normas legais e políticas internas;
  • Apoiar o desenvolvimento de quadros e ferramentas de RH, com foco em remuneração, gestão de desempenho, planejamento de sucessão e retenção de talentos, promovendo consistência técnica, sustentabilidade financeira e conformidade regulatória;
  • Responder a demandas técnicas e consultas complexas de clientes internos e fornecedores, interpretando políticas, procedimentos e práticas da área e garantindo sua aplicação adequada;
  • Conduzir treinamentos técnicos, briefings de gestão e comunicações com público interno, garantindo entendimento e disseminação das práticas de remuneração e recompensas por parte das lideranças;
  • Atuar no desenvolvimento contínuo de suas competências técnicas e de mercado, por meio de cursos, certificações, participação em fóruns, benchmarkings e estudos especializados, mantendo-se como referência técnica interna da área.

Diferenciais que buscamos:

  • Olhar analítico e estratégico para People Analytics, utilizando dados para gerar insights e apoiar decisões de remuneração e estrutura organizacional;
  • Habilidade com Power BI para criação de dashboards e relatórios dinâmicos, garantindo visualização clara e tomada de decisão baseada em dados.

About Sphise Technologies

Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted partner is expanding its financial operations and is seeking a Accounts Receivable / Billing Analyst to support billing processes, invoicing, and accounts receivable activities, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and timely revenue collection.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive AR/Billing Analyst to support billing operations, accounts receivable, and revenue-related processes. This role will be responsible for ensuring accurate invoicing, timely collections, and alignment between contracts and billing execution.

The ideal candidate combines strong attention to detail with hands-on experience in billing and accounts receivable, and is comfortable working cross-functionally to ensure accuracy and efficiency across the quote-to-cash cycle.

What You'll Do

  • Investigate and resolve billing discrepancies and customer inquiries

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to ensure correct contract implementation and billing accuracy
  • Support month-end close activities related to billing and accounts receivable
  • Contribute to improving and streamlining billing and collections processes
  • Assist in optimizing the quote-to-cash workflow
  • Support audits and ensure compliance with billing and financial policies

What You Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field
  • 3–5+ years of experience in accounts receivable, billing, or similar roles
  • Strong understanding of invoicing processes, collections, and revenue fundamentals
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Sales, Customer Success, or Operations teams
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets
  • Experience with ERP or billing systems (e.G., NetSuite, QuickBooks, SAP) is a plus
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Strong communication skills, especially when handling client-facing billing matter

Nice to Have

  • Experience with recurring billing models
  • Familiarity with quote-to-cash processes
  • Experience supporting audits and compliance processes
  • Background in process improvement and automation
  • Experience working in high-growth or scaling organizations

What We Offer

title: Ruby On Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.

THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.

You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity

BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams

YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department
